title: Corporate Account Executive - Public Sector
description: <p><strong>What will you be doing?</strong></p> <p>As Corporate Account Executive, Public Sector, you will own new-logo acquisition across a defined vertical and account set in the UK, Ireland and South Africa. Your focus will be public sector organisations with 2,000–7,499 employees. This is a dedicated new-business role and you are unlikely to inherit existing customers.</p> <p>You will use available account, industry and SKU growth data to create, own and execute a clear territory strategy focused on sustainable net-new ARR growth. You will manage the full sales cycle—from prospecting and opportunity creation through procurement, negotiation and close—while building trusted relationships with business, technical, procurement and executive stakeholders.</p> <p>This is a self-sourcing role. You will have access to Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Partner Account Management and marketing resources, but this support is intended to complement—not replace—your personal accountability for creating pipeline. As a channel-first organisation, close alignment with the Partner Account Manager and partner ecosystem will be central to how you develop routes to market, generate demand and win business. Customer Success support will become available once a customer reaches the applicable ARR threshold.</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Creating, validating, owning and executing a data-led territory and account plan that sets out how you will achieve an annual net-new ARR target of approximately $900,000 USD once fully ramped.</li> <li>Using account intelligence, industry trends, SKU performance and growth data to prioritise target accounts, identify whitespace and focus resources on the strongest ARR opportunities.</li> <li>Personally sourcing pipeline through disciplined prospecting, executive outreach, networking, events, social selling and account-based activity.</li> <li>Working with the BDR to increase coverage and accelerate opportunity creation, while retaining personal ownership of pipeline generation and territory performance.</li> <li>Leading new-logo acquisition across assigned public sector accounts within your defined vertical, with no reliance on an inherited customer base.</li> <li>Managing the full sales cycle from initial engagement and qualification through discovery, solution development, business case, procurement, negotiation and close.</li> <li>Operating effectively within a channel-first model by working closely with the PAM to build and execute partner-led account plans and routes to market.</li> <li>Developing productive relationships with resellers, framework providers, distributors, system integrators and strategic alliance partners to create pipeline and close business.</li> <li>Building and progressing opportunities through public procurement frameworks, tenders, direct awards and other compliant purchasing routes.</li> <li>Partnering with Solutions Engineering to shape discovery, technical validation, demonstrations and solution design around customer outcomes.</li> <li>Working with marketing to develop and execute targeted vertical, territory and account-based campaigns that generate measurable pipeline.</li> <li>Engaging Customer Success at the appropriate stage for customers that meet the applicable ARR threshold, ensuring a strong transition from sale to adoption.</li> <li>Managing complex sales cycles involving procurement, IT leadership, information governance, security, records management, finance and executive sponsors.</li> <li>Positioning AvePoint's platform solutions against public sector priorities including digital transformation, cyber resilience, AI adoption, compliance, data governance and modern workplace initiatives.</li> <li>Delivering compelling presentations, workshops and value-based business cases that demonstrate measurable outcomes, commercial impact and return on investment.</li> <li>Maintaining an accurate, current and sufficiently covered pipeline, forecast and account strategy within the CRM, with clear next steps and stakeholder ownership.</li> <li>Attending virtual and face-to-face customer meetings, partner engagements, industry events and conferences across the territory as required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Is this the role for you?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for someone who combines agility, passion, accountability and teamwork with the commercial drive to build a territory from the ground up. You will be comfortable creating your own opportunities, mobilising supporting resources and remaining accountable for the overall ARR outcome.</p> <p>You will understand how public sector organisations buy technology and be able to translate policy priorities, funding signals, market trends and customer challenges into focused account plans and commercially qualified opportunities.</p> <p>You will be strategic and data-led, but equally willing to execute. Success requires a consistent prospecting cadence, disciplined qualification, strong internal orchestration and effective use of BDR, SE, PAM and marketing support without becoming dependent on those resources for pipeline creation.</p> <p>If you enjoy winning new logos, developing partner-led routes to market, navigating complex public procurement and helping organisations achieve meaningful outcomes through technology, this role offers the opportunity to build and own a high-growth public sector territory.</p> <p><strong>Experience and qualities required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven success in a new-business software, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, information management or enterprise technology sales role.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to self-source, develop and close net-new business opportunities against an ARR or recurring-revenue target.</li> <li>Experience creating and executing a territory plan for a defined account set, segment or vertical.</li> <li>Experience selling into public sector organisations is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Understanding of public procurement processes, framework agreements, tendering environments and partner-led purchasing routes.</li> <li>A strong channel mindset, with experience working effectively with Partner Account Managers, resellers, system integrators and alliance ecosystems.</li> <li>Ability to use market, account and performance data to prioritise activity and make sound commercial decisions.</li> <li>Experience engaging and influencing executive, business, procurement and technical stakeholders.</li> <li>A consultative, value-based sales approach with the ability to develop credible business cases and articulate measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Strong prospecting, communication, presentation, negotiation and listening skills.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple complex opportunities and coordinate cross-functional resources without losing personal accountability.</li> <li>Strong forecasting discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline and account data in CRM systems.</li> <li>Resilience, curiosity, pace and a clear ownership mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Market-competitive compensation including bonus scheme </li> <li>Career progression and internal mobility opportunities</li> <li>30 days of annual leave, in addition to You’ll work directly with senior operations leadership working on special projects to diagnose demand drivers, uncover commercial opportunities, build KPI frameworks, and deploy automation that materially reduces our cost-to-serve while improving customer outcomes. If you’re technical, curious, and love owning problems end-to-end, this is the role for you. What You’ll Do 1. Automation & AI Engineering Use Python and LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI) to design and deploy automation that replaces manual CS/FS processes. Build prototypes, test with real operations data, and scale the successful ones into production workflows. Partner with PMs and engineers to operationalise AI-driven solutions across Operations. 2. Demand Analytics & Strategy Analyse key operations demand drivers (contact per customer, reason drivers, seasonality, servicing behaviour). Identify levers to reduce avoidable demand and improve customer outcomes. Build analytical models that drive decision-making around cost optimisation and resourcing. 3. KPI & Funnel Intelligence Build clear, robust KPI frameworks and funnel views across customer journeys. Translate data into commercial insight, operational efficiency recommendations, and productivity tracking. Create metrics that scale across new geographies, products, and teams. 4. Work With Senior Leadership Work directly with Ops Directors, Heads of CS/FS/Fraud/Complaints, and the COO on strategic initiatives. Turn raw data into narrative-driven recommendations that are simple, actionable, and commercially grounded. Own analytics for high-impact projects end-to-end. What We’re Looking For Must-Have Skills 2-3 years of hands-on experience using Python in a professional setting. Highly numerate with strong analytical reasoning Ability to independently structure analysis, build prototypes, and deliver insights. Experience communicating data-driven recommendations to non-technical business stakeholders . Nice-to-Haves STEM Degree Experience with dbt or modern data stacks. Familiarity with LLMs, APIs, or interest in building AI automation. Exposure to product, strategy, or operations environments. Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Comfortable wearing multiple hats Analyst , Data Scientist , AI Engineer , PM . Highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset, and excited by building the strongest operating model in fintech. Why Join Work on high-visibility, high-impact projects that directly shape the future of Lendable’s operations. Build automation and analytics used daily by hundreds of agents and thousands of customers. Collaborate with a small, sharp, and ambitious team that moves fast. Real ownership: if you build it, you’ll see it shipped and scaled. Interview process Screening Call + Python Questions Live Technical Python Interview Final interviews with 2 senior leaders Life at Lendable Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. title: Talent Partner
description: Healf is Europe's fastest-growing company. Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three. We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter. The next chapter is harder and more interesting. We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one. At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people. We're looking for a generalist Talent Partner to bring firepower to an AI-first talent team indexing heavily on talent density, candidate experience and hiring velocity. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with a few years recruiting experience in high-growth, venture backed companies who thrives on ownership, founder-level agency and building deep relationships with passive candidates in hard-to-hire markets. It's an end-to-end, generalist role; you'll be working across a range of searches from tech to commercial. You'll be based in our London office 3-4 days a week. This IC role is benchmarked for someone earlier in their career- you'll have a steep growth trajectory but it won't be the remit or provide growth for someone who's been longer tenured in a more senior position. Where you'll make an impact Talent density: Building talent networks of hard-to-hire, passive candidates who will move the needle for Healf on the business metrics that matter as we scale past £100m annual revenue. Ensuring meaningful optionality of candidates at offer-stage by running sprint-style, automation-enabled searches. Sourcing, assessing and closing candidates from entry through to senior experience levels. Candidate experience: There are known shortcomings today in our candidate experience and we see this person inputting on initiatives that will enable a more fluid, high-touch hiring process. Delivering exceptional, personalised narratives for candidates that resonate with their individual motivations. Contributing to an evolving candidate experience programme that makes Healf's interview loop a differentiator for candidates. Hiring velocity: Moving fast and being proactive in keeping hiring teams accountable on pace. Automating administrative burdens at top-of-funnel and within talent operations. Bringing exceptional instinct and pattern-spotting skills in understanding who's an exceptional fit for Healf. What you'll bring Bias for action and deep ownership Superb written and verbal communication skills Transparency and natural proclivity for leaning in to challenging conversations Demonstrable personal interest in health and wellbeing Exceptional pattern-spotting and critical thinking ability Excellent storytelling and relationship building ability both internally and externally Demonstrable experience of leveraging AI to level-up a hiring process Confidence learning new spaces and search criteria Positive energy and strong work ethic Our interview process 30 minutes with someone from the Talent team 30 minutes with Director, Talent 60 minutes case study with the Talent team 30 minutes with Lestat, Co-founder The Deal We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have. In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade. We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company. If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the Team Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies. We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and regulators to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all. About the role As a Lead Data Scientist, you'll take on a pivotal, entrepreneurial role, functioning as the technical expert who thrives on complexity and commercial impact. You will be responsible for setting the technical direction and ensuring the high-quality, scalable delivery of our most challenging, high-impact projects. This position combines deep expertise in machine learning with strategic oversight to define project roadmaps, manage technical risk, and architect reliable solutions. Your focus will be on driving innovation, mentoring cross-functional teams, and actively shaping both our technical standards and long-term customer relationships. What you'll be doing: Setting the technical direction for complex, business-critical projects and expertly balancing trade-offs between speed, innovation, and reliability. Designing and implementing reliable, production-grade technical solutions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of architectures and specifications. Defining project problems, developing clear roadmaps, and overseeing end-to-end delivery across multi-disciplinary workstreams. Leading technical scoping and feasibility studies for high-value sales opportunities and strategic customer engagements. Managing relationships and communications with technical stakeholders, fostering trust and aligning technical solutions with shared long-term commercial goals. Driving the adoption of best practices, shared resources, and robust technical processes across the wider Data Science craft. Mentoring and developing other data scientists and team members, actively contributing to the growth and technical excellence of the organisation. Who we're looking for: You have proven project management expertise, capable of dividing complex, ill-defined problems into actionable, clearly defined workstreams with timelines you can defend. You possess strong customer leadership skills, able to act as a trusted technical advisor and drive long-term strategic relationships with demanding clients. You bring depth of expertise in at least one machine learning domain and strong technical breadth across the entire data science landscape. You are a skilled technical leader, proficient in mentoring individuals, managing teams (including other managers), and rolling out impactful tools and workflows. You are adept at managing ill-defined, high-risk tasks, consistently delivering innovative and practical outcomes under commercial pressure. You excel at cross-functional collaboration, effectively aligning technical strategy with Engineering, Commercial, and Infrastructure teams. You have experience extending technical oversight to business unit-level initiatives, using your vision to influence and contribute to organisational success. The Interview Process Talent Team Screen (30 minutes) Introduction to the team (30 minutes) Take Home Technical Assessment Technical Interview (90 minutes) Commercial Interview (60 minutes) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts. We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters! [ Read our Impact Report ] | [ See our Trustpilot ] Enterprise Risk Manager We are looking for an Enterprise Risk Manager to join our team, with the main focus being on oversight, governance, and driving the strategic execution of Enterprise Risk management framework. Given the lean nature of the team, you will have significant autonomy, wide exposure across the business, and the opportunity to lead, influence, and shape our risk capability as we scale. The role Lead and provide expert advice & counsel on complex enterprise and operational risk-related matters across the business. Partner with senior stakeholders across key functions to identify, evaluate, challenge, and manage key risks and controls. Build strong, collaborative relationships across the organisation to drive strategic risk initiatives, build risk maturity, and foster a strong risk culture. Take end-to-end ownership of core elements of the Enterprise Risk Management framework, including KRIs, RCSAs, Operational Risk Event Management, and risk committee management. Drive continuous improvement and scalability of our Risk Governance tools (GRC software) and framework processes. Oversee, prepare, and present high-quality, impactful risk reporting for relevant Executive committees and Board documentation. Provide guidance, coaching, and direction to team members (including Risk Analysts/Senior Analysts) to support their development and drive team outcomes. Track and challenge risk actions, ensuring business owners have appropriate guidance to resolve root causes within agreed target dates. What we’re looking for Proven, deep experience in Enterprise or Operational Risk Management within financial services, risk consultancies, or Big 4 environments. Experience in SME lending, fintech, or fast-paced digital lending environments is highly desirable. Typically 5+ years of relevant work experience in Enterprise or Operational Risk Management, with demonstrated progression into managerial or senior advisory responsibilities. Strong strategic acumen, problem-solving, and analytical skills with the ability to translate complex risk concepts into clear business impacts. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills—capable of influencing and constructively challenging senior management. title: Manager, Engineering, Secure Build and SCS Services (East Coast Preferred)
description: About Docker Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default. _______________________________________________________________________ Secure Build builds and operates the infrastructure behind Docker's container builds. The team owns Docker Build Cloud and Docker Hub Automated Builds while developing the next generation of trusted build and CI capabilities. Its direction is to make Docker the trusted place CI runs: isolated execution, brokered access to secrets and networks, and verifiable evidence of what each build or test job did. The work spans Go services, container and build technology, cloud infrastructure, sandboxing and software supply-chain security, alongside the operational responsibility for production systems customers already depend on. SCS Services builds the backend systems and product capabilities that help developers understand, secure and ship software with confidence. The team powers important parts of Docker Scout and Docker Hardened Images, including the services and workflows that turn supply-chain data into useful developer, customer and agent experiences. Its estate is deliberately polyglot, with Clojure and Go services, event-driven workflows, Kafka, legacy Datomic components and newer Spanner-backed services. It also supports the customer journey around discovering, assessing, subscribing to and managing hardened artefacts. We are looking for one Engineering Manager to lead both teams. Together they sit at the centre of Docker's secure software supply-chain work: one creates trusted build outcomes, while the other turns build, artifact and dependency data into services and experiences used across Scout and Docker Hardened Images. This is a two-team leadership role with separate roadmaps, production responsibilities and technical domains. The teams should deliver independently, with explicit contracts and joined-up ownership where their services connect. You will own the health, delivery and growth of both teams and make the trade-offs that keep them effective as a portfolio. You will not be expected to be the deepest expert in every language or domain. You will need enough technical breadth and current engineering judgement to engage credibly in designs, reviews and incidents across both teams, set direction with strong senior engineers, and recognise when the right answer is to create space for their expertise. The kind of person we're looking for The successful candidate leads first. They are an experienced engineering manager who can inherit two capable teams, earn trust quickly and help each become a high-performing, value-delivering part of the wider Docker organisation. They are deliberate about where they spend their attention, protect both teams from becoming the second priority, and make portfolio trade-offs visible rather than allowing urgency, proximity or the loudest stakeholder to decide. They stay close to the technical work without trying to own every technical decision. They can hold a substantive conversation about distributed backend systems, event and data pipelines, build and CI infrastructure, trust boundaries and production operations. They are active in design and review, useful during incidents and willing to get hands-on where that moves the work forward. The balance still tilts strongly to leadership, coaching, delivery and organisational judgement. They care about security as a product and engineering property, not only as compliance. They understand how modern attacks exploit identity, secrets, dependencies and build systems, and they can reason about the evidence customers need to trust an artefact or workflow. They lead through judgement, clarity and unblocking rather than ceremony for its own sake. Above all, they grow the engineers around them and help both teams ship outcomes developers and enterprises can rely on. Responsibilities: Lead Secure Build and SCS Services, owning delivery, team health, growth, performance and operational excellence across both. Turn two changing roadmaps into a coherent portfolio plan with explicit priorities, capacity and trade-offs, and create leadership coverage so neither team becomes the permanent second priority. Partner with Product to shape strategy and roadmaps for secure build, Docker Scout, Docker Hardened Images and the services that connect them. Stay close to the technical work through design and code review, incident response and selective hands-on contribution where it adds leverage. Ensure each team's technical direction supports product, security, reliability and customer priorities, setting it collaboratively with Staff and senior engineers while leaving clear decision ownership with them. Own the interfaces between the teams, including trust boundaries, contracts, data quality, versioning, operational ownership and customer-facing failure modes. Balance new product work with inherited systems and on-call, and invest in reliability improvements driven by recurring operational pain. Own engineer growth and performance, handle difficult conversations directly, hire and retain strong people and build succession depth within both teams. Align Product, Design, Security, DHI Content, Registry, Hub, sales, support, commercial and legal partners while shielding the teams from churn. Lead disciplined use of AI-assisted engineering and communicate decisions, risks and progress clearly across UK and US working hours. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 5+ years managing high-performing engineering teams, with meaningful responsibility across more than one team or distinct technical domain. 8+ years of professional, hands-on software engineering experience in backend, infrastructure, platform or developer tooling. Experience leading, growing and retaining engineers at or above your own technical seniority, including teams you did not build and difficult performance conversations. A leader-first operating model, with current enough technical judgement to participate in design and review across unfamiliar systems without needing to be the best engineer in the room. Experience prioritising across competing roadmaps, operational load and stakeholder commitments, with clear mechanisms for allocating attention and capacity. Strong backend and distributed-systems judgement, including APIs, event-driven architectures, data stores, cloud-native infrastructure and production operations. Understanding of CI or build-system internals, containers and artefact workflows, plus a strong interest in software supply-chain security and trust boundaries. Experience leading teams that operate production infrastructure through on-call, incident response, observability, SLOs and the work required to reduce recurring operational load. Strong product judgement and evidence of shaping roadmaps with Product rather than only receiving requirements. Clear written and verbal communication, strong cross-functional influence, customer closeness and comfort leading a remote-first organisation across European and US time zones. Helpful, but Not Required Experience with Go, Clojure or both, and evidence of becoming effective across a polyglot estate. Experience with Kafka, Spanner, Datomic or comparable event-streaming and distributed-data systems. Experience with OCI, BuildKit, Buildx, GitHub Actions or comparable build and CI platforms. Experience with sandboxing, microVMs, untrusted workload execution or multi-tenant infrastructure. Experience with SLSA, in-toto, SBOMs, VEX, Sigstore, cosign, provenance, signing or vulnerability scanning. Experience evolving legacy systems while shipping new capability for developer tools, security products, regulated customers or software-agent workflows. What to expect First 30 days Build relationships with every engineer and the Product partners for both teams before changing structure, process or roadmap. Understand Secure Build's product direction, production estate and on-call load, including Docker Build Cloud and Docker Hub Automated Builds. Understand the SCS Services products, customers, architecture and operational profile, and map the dependencies, trust boundaries and ownership lines between the teams. First 90 days. Own a coherent portfolio plan with both teams and Product, including explicit capacity for roadmap, reliability and cross-team work. Establish a sustainable operating cadence and leadership coverage that prevents either team depending on your constant presence. Agree ownership and escalation paths for shared services and failures, start one material improvement in each team and make progress and risk visible. One year Outlook Both teams deliver predictably against a portfolio that connects secure build, Scout and Docker Hardened Images outcomes without collapsing their distinct missions. Secure Build has delivered material trusted-build or secure-CI capability and reduced operational risk in its inherited production systems. SCS Services has delivered material customer outcomes, while both teams have sustainable on-call, clearer ownership and senior engineers leading broader work. Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs. As we expand our business and take on new challenges in the form of acquired businesses or new ventures, finance is there to support every step of the way, leading to dynamic and challenging roles. Common characteristics among our team members are the ability to drive change, adaptability, and resourcefulness to ensure we can keep pace with the business, without compromising on financial control or sales performance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>Reporting into the Commercial CFO, the role is split into the below key areas:</p> <p><strong>Financial Control & Reporting</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Full ownership of divisional month‑end close processes across all Nutrition brands, including Myprotein.</li> <li>Build and lead the Nutrition consolidation and group reporting process following business separation.</li> <li>Ensure rigorous balance sheet governance, accuracy, and control across all teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercial Finance & Performance Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead commercial insights and analysis, challenging all aspects of the P&L to drive profitability.</li> <li>Deliver profit improvement and working capital initiatives across the division.</li> <li>Oversee budgeting and forecasting, providing both in‑month insight and rolling 12‑month projections to support strategic decision-making.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Leadership & Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support major strategic programmes including international expansion, organisational transformation, and business separation.</li> <li>Partner across all areas of the business—including supply chain, trading, and marketing—to ensure investments drive sustainable, profitable growth.</li> <li>Work collaboratively with group finance functions such as Tax, Treasury, and Group Reporting to ensure seamless alignment and compliance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership & Operations Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, motivate, and develop a multi‑disciplinary finance team of up to 25 colleagues.</li> <li>Oversee day‑to‑day finance operations, ensuring an efficient, well‑controlled, and high‑performing finance function.</li> <li>Drive a proactive, solutions‑led approach to identifying risks and opportunities across the short, medium, and long term.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Within these areas the role will require:</strong></p> <ul> <li>An inspirational leader, who thrives on being able to drive and work with an ambitious team to achieve goals aligned to the business’ need.</li> <li>A proactive approach to P&L performance, acting quickly on both risks and opportunities identified in both the short, medium and long term.</li> <li>A confident mindset, comfortable in dealing with a wide range of non-financial key stakeholders and managing difficult conversations.</li> <li>Comfortable to challenge and review spend approvals to ensure all costs deliver incremental benefit to the business.</li> <li>A strong attention to detail to ensure a tightly controlled balance sheet is delivered consistently, reviewing the wider team’s work.</li> <li>A keen ability to multi-task across a number of areas and manage both their own and the teams time effectively.</li> <li>An ability to communicate with wider finance functions outside of the division, including Group, Tax, Treasury etc, to ensure all relevant information is provided and received for reporting purposes.</li> <li>A collaborative approach to working with the wider divisional finance team including commercial, to assist with reporting and profit delivery, and SSC, to ensure a tightly controlled working capital cycle</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Fully qualified optimisation, budgeting and forecasting.</li> <li>A credible and influential strategic partner, confident in challenging and guiding non‑financial stakeholders at all levels.</li> <li>Experience supporting major strategic initiatives such as international expansion, transformation programmes, or business separations.</li> <li>Strong people leader with experience managing and developing large, multi‑disciplinary finance teams.</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail combined with the ability to operate strategically across a broad agenda.</li> <li>Excellent communicator capable of operating effectively across divisional and group finance environments.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in consumer goods, beauty, personal care, or FMCG improvements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for me?</strong></p> <p><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by title: Chief of Staff - UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.</p></div><p> </p> <h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p>This is a high-impact opportunity to work directly alongside one of Banyan’s seasoned Operating Leaders, each overseeing a portfolio of software businesses in a buy, hold and grow investment model. As <strong>Chief of Staff</strong>, you become a trusted right hand to your Operating Leader and a close working partner to the CEOs and functional leaders across their companies.</p> <p>The role is deliberately broad. Rather than a fixed rotation, you will move across multiple operating companies and business problems: shaping a go-to-market plan for one company, improving customer onboarding at another, or standing up the first 100 days of a newly acquired business. You will gain exposure to software M&A, but the core of the job is hands-on value creation and operating work. You own initiatives end to end.</p> <p>The <strong>Executive Leadership Program</strong> (ELP) runs two years. Development is intentional. You will work through a range of experiences spanning go-to-market, M&A, customer, and finance priorities portfolio-wide, plus gain hands-on leadership reps, with regular check-ins and development opportunities to ready you for your next role. High performers move from the ELP program into a CEO or C-suite role within a Banyan operating company, or into a leadership role at Banyan Software HQ.</p> <p>For those who want to learn how great vertical software businesses are built and run, and who want the fastest path available to running one themselves, this is the job.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Gain</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A cohort of high-calibre peers</strong>. You grow and learn alongside other ELPs at Banyan, building a long-term network of future operators.</li> <li><strong>Direct apprenticeship with senior operators</strong>. You will work very closely with an Operating Leader and see first-hand how experienced leaders make decisions across different software businesses.</li> <li><strong>Dedicated development support</strong>. External executive coaching in Year 2, plus mentorship from Operating Leaders with decades of software experience.</li> <li><strong>The fastest track we offer to running a business</strong>. High performers move directly from this program into a C-suite seat inside a Banyan operating company or a leadership role at HQ. It is not guaranteed, performance decides placement, but it is the first place Banyan looks when those seats open and we have a strong track record of placing CEOs through our ELP.</li> <li><strong>Real operating reps, not case reps</strong>. You carry a genuine initiative inside a live business and leadership-level stretch assignments, decisions that show up in a P&L.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Will Own</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Portfolio Value Creation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with CEOs and functional leaders across multiple operating companies to identify priorities and implement the Banyan Operating System, turning strategy into measurable operational improvements.</li> <li>Lead high-impact, cross-functional projects across product, go-to-market, sales, marketing, pricing, and customer success as the right hand to Leader.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>M&A and Integration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Gain exposure to Banyan’s acquisition process, including value-creation plan framing during diligence.</li> <li>Support integration planning and onboarding for newly acquired businesses, helping establish operating rhythms and priorities while respecting what already makes each business work.</li> <li>Help execute the value-creation plan once a deal closes, turning the diligence thesis into the specific operating bets a business needs to win in year one.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Executive Partnership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Support your Operating Leader on critical initiatives, executive decision-making, and cross-company collaboration, frequently influencing outcomes without formal authority or direct reports.</li> <li>Build the judgment, breadth, and pattern recognition required for future general management by working different business problems across a portfolio of vertical software companies.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Must-Haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Recently graduated from a top MBA program. This cycle is not open to first-year MBA students.</li> <li>2–5 years of pre-MBA experience in an operating role (product, business operations, portfolio operations, or value creation), management consulting, private equity, or investment banking, with a demonstrated record of owning measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and interpersonal judgment, with the ability to synthesize complex information and influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.</li> <li>High learning agility and comfort with ambiguity. You get smart quickly in unfamiliar areas, prioritize what matters, and move from analysis to action.</li> <li>Low ego and high ownership. You are ambitious but humble, seek feedback, build trust quickly, and are motivated by the work of operating a business rather than by title.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in software, SaaS, or another recurring revenue business. Familiarity with vertical software economics is an advantage.</li> <li>Experience leading a team. Direct people management is not required; this role initially relies on leadership through influence.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.</p> <p><strong>Please Note</strong>: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed.</p> <div><em><strong>Recruitment Notice</strong></em></div> <div>Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.</div> <p> </p> <p><em><strong>Beware of Recruitment Scams</strong></em></p> <p>We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. </p> <p><strong>Protect yourself by following these steps:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an ----- email address.</li> <li>Remember, employers will <strong>never</strong> request payment or banking information during the hiring process.</li> <li>If you receive a suspicious message, <strong>do not respond</strong> — instead, forward it to <a ---------- and/or report it to the platform where you received it.</li> </ul> <p>Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.</p> <div id="fortidlp-input-element-parent"></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Growth at Kraken is being rebuilt around an AI-native platform. Instead of people manually building audiences, writing copy, adjusting budgets, and scheduling sends, agents find opportunities, make decisions, and execute across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels. They learn from every result and keep going. People still run the system. Operators use a central hub to set the rules the agents follow, review and approve what they produce, and handle exceptions when something doesn’t fit. The platform also has to work across many markets and languages, and it operates in a regulated industry, so there are compliance checks and approval steps built in. The team is a small, cross-functional group of growth, product, and engineering people who build this platform and run it day to day. We ship often, learn fast, and raise the quality bar with every release. You will work most closely with the engineers building the platform, the product team defining how operators use it, and the operators who rely on it every day. QA and operations is how the whole team knows the platform can be trusted. The opportunity You will own day-to-day operations and QA for our internal growth platform. You test it, catch problems before our customers do, keep approvals and exception queues moving, and report on how it’s performing. You will work closely with product, engineering and operators to make sure the platform works and keeps working. This is a hands-on, detail-focused role. You will spend your days in the product, testing what’s new, checking what should already work, and writing up what you find so it gets fixed. Test the platform regularly. Cover new releases, rule changes, and edge cases, and run regression checks to make sure existing features still work. Find bugs and document them clearly, with steps to reproduce, severity, and impact. Follow them through until engineering fixes them and you’ve verified the fix. Monitor platform performance and agent activity, flag anything that looks wrong, and escalate it to the right person. Work the approval queues daily. Keep items moving and make sure nothing is left unreviewed. Check agent output against defined checklists and standards, and escalate anything unclear or risky.Note where flows are confusing or inconsistent, and flag them to the team. Write and maintain documentation: test plans, QA checklists, runbooks, and release notes. What you bring Experience in QA, testing, operations, support, or analytics, ideally on a software product or complex system Exceptional attention to detail. Your bug reports and documentation should be easy for anyone to follow. Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard and tell when a number looks off. Fast learner. You pick up new tools and systems quickly and ask thoughtful questions. AI-native habits. You use AI tools in your own work every day, and you’re curious about where they get things wrong. Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs Reliability. You keep to a routine, keep your queues clear, and tell people early when something is stuck. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. About LangChain At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We provide the agent engineering platform and open source frameworks developers need to ship reliable agents fast. Our open source frameworks, LangChain and LangGraph, see over 90+ million downloads per month and help developers build agents with speed and granular control. LangSmith offers observability, evaluation, and deployment for rapid iteration, enabling teams to transform LLM systems into dependable production experiences. LangChain is trusted by millions of developers worldwide and powers AI teams at companies like Replit, Clay, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, Workday, and more. About the role: We’re hiring Sales Development Representatives to join our SDR team and help shape the future of how companies adopt LangChain. As part of our SDR team, you’ll turn high inbound interest and targeted outbound demand into qualified opportunities and create an exceptional first-touch experiences for prospects. You’ll work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Operations alongside using LangChain and LangGraph-powered agents to automate list building, enrichment, and outreach freeing you to focus entirely on high-impact prospecting and conversations with teams exploring agentic AI. Partner closely with Account Executives to hand off qualified opportunities and ensure a smooth buyer experience. Capture and share insights from conversations to inform our sales plays, product roadmap, and agent development. Experiment with new channels, messaging, and automation to continuously increase conversion and efficiency. Use LangChain powered agents to test, learn, and improve prospecting strategies How to be successful in this role: 1–2 years of experience in a Sales, SDR, or BDR role within SaaS or technology (or strong curiosity and drive if you’re early in your career) Clear, confident communicator who can engage both technical and business audiences Motivated by learning, iteration, and experimentation you treat outreach like a craft Comfortable with a mix of structure and ambiguity you can execute repeatable processes while improving them along the way Excited about modern sales tech, AI tools, and shaping how next-generation GTM teams operate Positive, persistent, and highly organized you follow up, follow through, and bring energy to every interaction Compensation & Benefits Compensation: We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits such as health and dental coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, and life insurance. title: Product Manager, Homepage
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at <a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><p style="text-align: left;">Verve is a global ad-tech company that owns and operates a fully integrated advertising stack, spanning demand, supply, and data. This means our technology works end to end, in real time, every time a user opens an app or loads a screen.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><br>We reach 2.5 billion consumers across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. Our platform processes billions of signals daily, enabling advertisers to plan and execute campaigns with precision and publishers to manage and monetize their inventory effectively. As the digital advertising landscape shifts away from walled gardens and third-party identifiers, Verve is focused on building the infrastructure that supports a more open, accountable internet. That is what drives the work we do.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><br><strong>About the Position</strong><br>We are seeking a results-driven Senior Product Manager / Product Manager to own key commercial and technical areas of Verve’s core programmatic Marketplace. In this role you will lead cross-functional product execution alongside engineering, yield, commercial, and operations teams. You will be responsible for moving product initiatives from intake to structured execution, driving measurable improvements in our marketplace performance, publisher yield, and DSP spend velocity. Depending on your background and expertise, you will take ownership of one of our core exchange focus areas.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><br><strong>Position Responsibilities</strong><br>● buyer spend, improve yield, or streamline publisher onboarding.<br>● Seamless cross-functional alignment between Engineering Tech Leads, Product Leadership, Commercials teams and Yield Ops.</p> <p title: Lead Bid Manager, UK&I (Public Sector technology)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>Lead Bid Manager, UK & Ireland</strong></p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>As a Lead Bid Manager, you will lead Axon’s most complex and highest-impact RFP and tender responses, proposals, and other customer-facing selling documents across the UK and Ireland. You’ll be a member of a global team that supports Axon sales worldwide and will serve as the senior proposal execution lead for the region. You will own proposal development from early procurement engagement through submission and evaluation-period follow-up, translating established win strategy into a controlled response plan and ensuring the final submission is compliant, responsive, scorable, customer-focused, and on time. Your strengths in judgment under ambiguity, cross-functional leadership, technical and proposal writing, and compliance discipline will be central to success.</p> <p>Focused primarily on UK and Ireland public-sector opportunities, you will work closely with Sales, Bid Strategy, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, Pricing, Finance, Services, and executive stakeholders. You will personally lead the hardest pursuits while also strengthening regional proposal readiness, reusable standards, coaching, and execution across bids owned by other Proposal Managers. This is an office-based position in the United Kingdom.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do </strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> hybrid schedule of Monday working remotely, and Tue-Fri in our London office<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director, Global Proposals<br><strong>Direct Reports:</strong> N/A</p> <p>At Axon, the Lead Proposal Manager is the senior owner of proposal execution for the region’s most complex pursuits. You will engage early in the procurement process, establish how the response will be run, make execution and compliance decisions within approved boundaries, and carry the proposal through submission and evaluation-period deliverables. This is a comprehensive individual-contributor role requiring expertise in the following areas:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Proposal Planning & Execution:</strong> Translate established win strategy into an executable response architecture, including workstreams, assignments, proof collection, review cadence, decision gates, and submission-readiness criteria. Build pre-bid readiness for anticipated strategic procurements with Sales and Bid Strategy. Drive resolution of product exceptions, compliance issues, and proposal commitments through the appropriate approval paths, while partnering with Sales, Bid Strategy, Pricing, and leadership on commercial, account-strategy, and bid decisions.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong> Lead large cross-functional teams across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, Pricing, Finance, Services, Proposal Team members, and executive stakeholders. Drive decisions, close gaps, enforce deadlines, adjudicate conflicting review input, and coach Proposal Managers and Specialists to improve execution judgment, compliance discipline, and independent ownership.</li> <li><strong>Project & Compliance Management:</strong> Own proposal governance, milestones, compliance traceability, mandatory requirements, forms, schedules, portals, review cycles, final packaging, and submission readiness. Identify and manage disqualification and responsiveness risks, and preserve proposal context through structured handoff of assumptions, exceptions, commitments, and unresolved risks during clarification, presentation, and other evaluation-period activity.</li> <li><strong>Proposal Writing & Solution Fluency:</strong> Develop technical and solution fluency to challenge weak claims, identify risk, and frame partial or non-compliant requirements carefully. Write, edit, and integrate high-value content when SME inputs are incomplete, inconsistent, overly technical, or insufficiently responsive, producing a coherent response for technical and non-technical evaluators.</li> <li><strong>Regional Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration:</strong> Build strong operating relationships with UK and Ireland Sales and technical leaders, monitor regional delivery health, identify where pursuits need additional support or escalation, and provide Proposal Leadership with recommendations on complex-pursuit routing and resourcing. Identify repeatable success and failure patterns and improve regional execution through reusable standards, tools, proof sources, training, and workflow changes.</li> </ul> <p>What You Bring</p> <ul> <li>Typically 8+ years of proposal, bid, tender, or comparable pursuit experience, including repeated end-to-end ownership of large, ambiguous, high-stakes submissions with significant cross-functional stakeholder load and formal review cycles.</li> <li>Strong UK public-sector tender experience, including procurement routes, evaluation structures, frameworks and call-offs, mandatory requirements, submission mechanics, and evaluator expectations.</li> <li>Experience with major policing, blue-light/public safety, central government, defence/security, justice, or complex public-sector technology procurements is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading responses with strict compliance, controlled submission, and potential disqualification or non-responsive risk, with sound judgment about execution tradeoffs, prioritization of competing risks and deadlines, and when Product, Legal, Pricing, or strategy approval is required.</li> <li>Excellent proposal writing and editing skills, combined with the technical learning agility to challenge claims, identify solution risk, and turn uneven or highly technical inputs into clear, evaluator-focused, defensible content.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, handle constructive conflict, and escalate with clear options and a recommended path.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to improve proposal execution beyond personally owned bids through standards, tools, processes, training, proof sources, or other reusable practices.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to coach Proposal Managers or other proposal practitioners and improve their independent execution quality.</li> <li>Comfort with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Salesforce or comparable CRM, proposal-management platforms such as QorusDocs, Responsive/RFPIO, or Qvidian, and AI-enabled workflow tools. Formal proposal-development training or exposure to Shipley, APMP, Sant, or equivalent is preferred; strong tool judgment and learning agility matter more than experience with any one platform.</li> </ul> <p>Benefits that Benefit You</p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation and UK retirement benefits</li> <li>Company bonus scheme</li> <li>30 days paid time off</li> <li>Private medical insurance and health cash plan</li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Numerous insurance coverages (disability, long-term sick etc.)</li> <li>Health and wellbeing benefits</li> <li>Learning & Development programs</li> <li>Office amenities</li> <li style="font-style: italic;"><em>...and many more.</em></li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and eligibility are governed by Axon's applicable UK plans and policies and may vary based on the nature of your employment and work location.</em></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement?
