title: Frontier Agent Engineering Manager, Enterprise
description: <h2><strong>About Scale AI</strong></h2> <p>Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI initiatives through our data annotation platform, generative AI solutions, and enterprise AI capabilities.</p> <h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2> <p>As a Forward Deployed AI Engineering Manager on our Enterprise team, you'll be the technical bridge between Scale AI's cutting-edge AI capabilities and our most strategic customers. You'll work with enterprise clients to understand their unique challenges, lead a team that architects specific AI solutions, and ensure successful deployment and adoption of AI systems in production environments.</p> <p>This is a Management role that combines deep engineering and AI expertise, leading a team, and working on customer-facing problems. You'll work directly with customer engineering teams to integrate AI into their critical workflows.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Customer Integration & Deployment</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their technical infrastructure, data pipelines, and business requirements</li> <li>Design and implement custom integrations between Scale AI's platform and customer data environments (cloud platforms, data warehouses, internal APIs)</li> <li>Build robust data connectors and ETL pipelines to ingest, process, and prepare customer data for AI workflows</li> <li>Deploy and configure AI models and agents within customer security and compliance boundaries</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI Agent Development</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Develop production-grade AI agents tailored to customer use cases across domains like customer support, data analysis, content generation, and workflow automation</li> <li>Architect multi-agent systems that orchestrate between different models, tools, and data sources</li> <li>Implement evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance and iterate toward business objectives</li> <li>Design human-in-the-loop workflows and feedback mechanisms for continuous agent improvement</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Prompt Engineering & Optimization</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create sophisticated prompt engineering strategies optimized for customer-specific domains and data</li> <li>Build and maintain prompt libraries, templates, and best practices for customer use cases</li> <li>Conduct systematic prompt experimentation and A/B testing to improve model outputs</li> <li>Implement RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems and fine-tuning pipelines where appropriate</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Leadership & Collaboration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the Engineering Manager and technical point of contact for strategic enterprise accounts</li> <li>Lead a team that is collaborating with customer data scientists, ML engineers, and software developers to ensure smooth integration</li> <li>Work closely with Scale's product and engineering teams to translate customer needs into product improvements</li> <li>Document technical architectures, integration patterns, and best practices</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Problem Solving & Innovation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Debug complex technical issues across the entire stack, from data pipelines to model outputs</li> <li>Rapidly prototype solutions to unblock customers and prove out new use cases</li> <li>Stay current on the latest AI/ML research and tools, bringing innovative approaches to customer problems</li> <li>Identify opportunities for productization based on common customer patterns</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of software engineering experience with 3+ yrs of </strong> <strong>Management experience </strong>with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design</li> <li><strong>Production Python expertise</strong> with experience in modern ML/AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace, OpenAI API)</li> <li><strong>Experience with cloud platforms</strong> (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern data infrastructure</li> <li><strong>Strong problem-solving skills</strong> with the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and rapidly iterate toward solutions</li> <li><strong>Excellent communication skills</strong> with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2> <p><em>Agent Development Wiz</em></p> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of LLMs including prompting techniques, embeddings, and RAG architectures</li> <li>Experience building and deploying AI agents or autonomous systems in production</li> <li>Knowledge of vector databases and semantic search systems</li> <li>Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects</li> </ul> <p><em>Infrastructure Guru</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Experience using Terraform, Bicep, or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools</li> <li>Previous work in a devops, platform, or infra role</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA)</li> </ul> <p><em>Customer Product Whisperer</em></p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to work with customers in a technical consulting, solutions engineering, or product engineering role</li> <li>Domain expertise in verticals like finance, healthcare, government, or manufacturing</li> <li>Experience with technical enablement or teaching programs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Sample Projects</strong></h2> <p>The following are some examples of the types of projects we’ve worked on with customers. All of these projects leverage customer data, integrate directly into customers’ existing systems, and are deployed on their infrastructure.</p> <h3><strong>Deep Research for Due Diligence</strong></h3> <p>For a global professional services firm, we developed a sophisticated deep research agent to assist in due diligence. This agent employs a multi-agent architecture for robust fact-checking, integrates several internal MCP tools, and processes complex, unstructured data sources. This solution reliably saves employees hundreds of hours weekly.</p> <h3><strong>Churn Prediction</strong></h3> <p>Working with a TelCo organization, we built a model utilizing customer data to predict churn likelihood. The system then curates personalized offers based on this prediction. This model was integrated into a "next best action" copilot, enabling call center agents to proactively surface relevant offers to customers, leading to a significant reduction in churn.</p> <h3><strong>Data Extraction Voice Agent</strong></h3> <p>We partnered with a healthcare organization to create a lifelike voice agent and avatar designed to gather unstructured health information from patients. Engineered for low latency, the agent adeptly manages conversational flow, adheres to safety guardrails, and efficiently handles data extraction. This automation saves the organization's nurses hundreds of hours each week.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE: </em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, </em><em>Ernst</em><em> </em><em>&</em><em> Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. </em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at ----- Please see the United States Department of Labor's </em><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf"><em>Know Your Rights poster</em></a><em> for additional information.</em></p> <p><em>We comply with the United States Department of Labor's </em><em>Pay Transparency provision</em><em>. </em></p> <p><em><strong>PLEASE NOTE: </strong>We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our <a href="https://scale.com/legal/privacy" target="_blank">privacy policy</a> for additional information.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Executive Assistant, Data Center Operations EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave is building the next-generation public cloud for accelerated workloads, and our team is growing rapidly. As part of the Administrative & Operations function, you will support executives who are driving high-impact, cross-company initiatives. We value adaptability, ownership, and a sense of humor as we move fast and scale quickly.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>In this role, you will provide support for 2-3 senior executives, ensuring they can operate efficiently and stay focused on top priorities. You will manage complex scheduling across multiple time zones, coordinate travel and expenses, and support key team activities including meetings, offsites, and reporting. You’ll play a central role in keeping the leadership team organized, informed, and moving forward by anticipating needs, driving follow-ups, and handling sensitive information with discretion. This position requires someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, and able to execute with minimal oversight.</p> <h3><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience providing executive support to VP-level or above<br><br></li> <li>Proven project management experience<br><br></li> <li>Proficiency with Google Suite, Google Calendar, Slack, and Microsoft Office<br><br></li> <li>Experience coordinating travel logistics and processing expense reports<br><br></li> <li>Experience with event planning and meeting coordination<br><br></li> <li>Demonstrated ability to improve or streamline processes<br><br></li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines across time zones<br><br></li> <li>Strong written communication skills, including drafting and editing documents<br><br></li> <li>Ability to independently execute tasks with high accuracy and attention to detail<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously<br><br></li> <li>Experience working in a high-growth or rapidly scaling environment<br><br></li> <li>Familiarity with cross-functional coordination and leadership support<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</strong></h3> <p>We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring diverse experiences — even if you aren’t a perfect match on every skill. If some of this sounds like you, we’d love to talk:</p> <ul> <li>You love creating order out of complexity and helping leaders operate at their best<br><br></li> <li>You’re curious about how teams work and constantly look for ways to improve processes<br><br></li> <li>You’re an expert in staying organized and keeping cross-functional work on track<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong><strong><br><br></strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility). </em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications </em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. (“Controller”), which is located at</em></p> <p><em>Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA</em></p> <p><em>and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. You may request a copy of the suitable mechanisms we have in place by contacting us at </em><a ---------- <p><em>Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Where permitted by applicable law, we may also retain your personal data for a limited period after the recruitment process ends in order to consider you for future job opportunities, respond to legal claims, or comply with record-keeping obligat

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description: <h2>Alloy is where you belong!</h2> <p>Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.<br><br>Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of <a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/alloy_ny" target="_blank">Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces</a>, <a href="https://www.forbes.com/companies/alloy/?list=americas-best-startup-employers&sh=55c076453c61" target="_blank">Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers</a>, <a href="https://www.americanbanker.com/list/best-places-to-work-in-fintech-2022" target="_blank">Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker</a>, year after year.<br><br>Check out our investors and read more about us <a href="https://www.alloy.com/about" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Solutions Architects play a major role in Alloy’s Technical Solutions organization and are paramount to deal success. The Solutions Architect is responsible for delivering the technical win for client accounts. You will handle the technical post-sales relationship, present product fit, propose technical architectures, demonstrate the product, anticipate concerns, and offer creative technical solutions to Alloy clients.</p> <p>Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our employees onsite three days a week.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll:</p> <ul> <li>Act as the technical lead on multiple client implementations and larger client project engagements, working closely with Alloy Implementations Managers</li> <li>Conduct technical and architectural overviews of client needs to propose Alloy product solutions to deliver on the client’s business goals</li> <li>Act as an expert advisor on the data vendors Alloy integrates with</li> <li>Help to integrate Alloy's API into an app in code</li> <li>Independently run end to end testing to ensure a successful client go live</li> <li>Be a part of a client production readiness and support production launches (these occasionally occur outside of 9a-5p hours)</li> <li>Serve as a client advocate by advocating for the evolution of Alloy’s products and services and driving client adoption of new capabilities </li> <li>Support the development of technical documentation and FAQs to serve client needs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who we’re looking for</strong></h2> <p>You are both highly technical and a skilled relationship builder. You are comfortable in front of a variety of audiences, from explaining Alloy’s best practices to a bank’s compliance team to mapping an API flow on a whiteboard with a Fintech product and Engineering team. Alloy’s post-sales process is highly consultative and requires our team to be flexible, creative, and empathetic.</p> <ul> <li>4+ years experience implementing and supporting complex technical products with a strong desire to work in a post-sales, client-facing role</li> <li>Experience working in the fraud, KYC/KYB, Risk/Compliance and/or at a Fintech Startup</li> <li>Hands-on, passionate and creative problem solver</li> <li>Brings judgement to client discussions, focused on leading clients to successful outcomes aligned with their long term business goals</li> <li>Excellent communicator and presenter able to gain diverse audience confidence and buy-in</li> <li>Ability to build a deep understanding of a client's needs and guide them to a technical solution</li> <li>Proven success in problem-solving with and for enterprises with a variety of requirements and technical ability levels</li> <li>Experience working with REST APIs</li> <li>Previous software development experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: <ul> <li>backend (Node.js, Python)</li> <li>web development (Javascript, HTML/CSS, frontend frameworks - React)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Able to travel occasionally (approximately once per quarter) for client on-sites.</li> </ul> <p>We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?</p> <p>Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!</p> <h2>Benefits and Perks </h2> <ul> <li>Unlimited holiday and flexible work policy</li> <li>Pension with employee contribution</li> <li>Up to 100% compensation for 16 weeks of parental leave</li> <li>Home office stipend for new employees</li> <li>Annual £900 learning & development stipend</li> <li>Equity plan</li> <li>Uncapped commissions</li> <li>Training programs to help foster growth (Alloy Foundations, Alloy Lead, Etc.)</li> <li>Private health and dental care</li> </ul> <h2>How to apply</h2> <p>Apply right here! You've found the application!</p> <p>Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Group Overview: </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Metrea Management </span></strong><span data-contrast="none">is our global shared service providing support for the Capabilities in areas such as People, Finance, Legal, Strategy, Safety, Security and Information Technology. </span> <br><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas—including airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special mission aviation, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. Whenever we operate, we build vertically integrated full stacks of capability—designing, building, and operating turnkey solutions that let customers scale capacity while benefiting from continuous cycles of innovation. With operators and engineers under one roof, we close the gap between lab and field—what we call connecting design with effect. Metrea’s solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving. This approach enables our partners to do more with less and achieve outsized, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Metrea has facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and beyond.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":288}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Position Summary </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":288}"> </span></p> <p>At Metrea, we seek out the most complex national security challenges and proactively develop elegant solutions. title: Affiliate and Influencer Marketer
description: Granola is the AI notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. We're growing fast and looking for a hands-on affiliate / influencer / creator marketer to help us scale our partnership programmes across evergreen and launch campaigns. This is an individual contributor role. The opportunity We are looking for an affiliate and influencer marketer to join our team at Granola. We work with hundreds of creators and publishers to support acquiring new users through partnerships (sponsorships, affiliation and hybrid models). You'll sit at the intersection of branding and growth, making sure we’re proud of the online narratives around Granola and checking the performance of our influencer marketing efforts at a channel and partner level. What you’ll do Own a creator portfolio : Be responsible for growing and looking after a large portfolio of key accounts (sponsored, affiliates or hybrid) and regularly keeping in touch with them to increase Granola’s presence on their different channels Newsletter sponsorships : You'll own this channel end to end, from partner onboarding and booking through live-date tracking, invoicing, and performance reporting. Influencer partnerships : Sourcing and onboarding great creators for authentic collaborations. Instead of an ad placement, you’ll do demos of granola, find ideas and creative briefs for the influencers that would bring new user acquisitions too YouTube collaborations : Running campaigns with youtube creators to meet internal priorities through integrations, dedicated videos and editorial projects. Example projects you might work on Newsletter creatives : draft launch announcements and evergreen copy, and work with our design and copywriting team to get assets for our ads placements. Review editorial pieces for accuracy and brand safety. AEO portfolio. Increase the amount of citations on LLM through YouTube partnerships and listicle sponsorships, measuring the impact on citations from your work Account management : being the point of contact for a portfolio of affiliates / creators with large audiences, building win-win deals and generating authentic content. Your background looks something like… 3 years in influencer / affiliate marketing , brand-side or agency side. You’ve worked on significant creator collaborations that had tangible business impact (we’ll ask for example of campaigns you’ve run or a portfolio) A track record of managing a large portfolio of accounts and co-building the systems to support working with hundreds of vendors and deals at once, without sacrificing the quality of deliverables Experience working at a startup or scale up, preferably in tech, AI or B2B SaaS space. You understand the future of work and Granola’s ICP (enterprise and self-serve) As a person, you… Have high-agency and business acumen. You’re able to autonomously allocate budget, negotiate with creators, unstuck collaborations including at-risk accounts Are AI-native but know when to use it and when it is an overkill Are extremely good at prioritizing - picking what will really move the needles with goals and saying no to what is just busy work Have deep interest, curiosity and understanding around the creator economy and brand partnerships. You know that the playbooks get constantly re-written and you proactively keep up with the industry. Are chronically online and already know partners that would be a great fit for Granola. Bonus if you have existing relationships with creators, publishers and key opinion leaders that would be a great fit for Granola. Are creative and can select creators who have a tasteful editorial line and content style. You’d be able to scout the partners we’d be proud to collaborate with not only through data but also by instincts. Your experience helps you tell who can build trust and influence. About the opportunity This is the opportunity to come shape the narrative of Granola with creators while generating measurable growth, on the branding and user acquisition side, and create business impact at one of the fastest growing AI company in London. We work primarily together in London (office-first). You can find more about the team, how we work and our benefits on our careers page . If this sounds like work you’d love doing, we’d like to hear from you—even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. Compensation Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Executive
description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. What you'll be doing You will work through the new and existing business leads by making outbound calls to prospective customers, helping them through the sales process. You'll deal with incoming sales calls, mid-term adjustments, renewals and returning customers. You will assess customers insurance needs and advice on appropriate Zego insurance products, whilst always following compliance guidelines. You will ensure customer satisfaction and provide professional customer support over phone, live chat and email. You will maintain a positive, empathetic and professional attitude towards customers at all times and build productive trust relationships. You will respond promptly to customer inquiries whilst making sure all communication is documented and logged in our internal system. You will follow GDPR guidelines and processes in all communication with customers What you will need to be successful You will have proven skills working within a high performing target-driven customer call centre- sales and service environment, ideally in a call centre setting. You've worked in a high target environment, high revenue, daily call targets. You are obsessive about customer experience and act as an advocate for our customer’s needs. You're able to listen to customers and be able to give advice and support. You have an ability to multitask, set priorities and manage time effectively. You will have a good understanding of GDPR rules and regulations and be able to use multiple systems at the same time. Ideally, you will have experience in insurance or an FCA regulated business. The Zego ways of working 🏡 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like . Benefits 🎁 💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year. 🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution. 📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build 🩺 Private medical insurance. 🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new. 💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you. Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. title: Developer Portal & Community Manager
description: We are the creators of Flipper Zero — a portable device for tech enthusiasts and engineers. It’s a gadget with an awesome community that brings together millions of people around the world. We’re building a new product — Flipper One . It’s a full-featured ARM-based computer running Linux in a compact form factor, powered by the Rockchip RK3576 SoC. We’ve decided to make the entire development process completely open and public. That’s why we’re looking for a Developer Portal & Community Manager to own and manage the entire Flipper One Developer Portal: maintaining the wiki, collecting tasks from all development teams, managing all GitHub projects and repositories, and proactively communicating with the community. This role is perfect for you if you want to be close to the product, see firsthand how it’s built, and help turn that process into a clear and valuable entry point for the community. This is not a “content manager” role — you’ll need to fully understand the development process, track all ongoing tasks, and connect the team with the community to make things happen. What is the Developer Portal? The Developer Portal is a public wiki + a set of GitHub projects built around Flipper One. It documents how the project works as a whole, explains the architecture of its major subsystems, and provides contribution guides for the community — showing how people can contribute to each sub-project. Anyone reading the Developer Portal wiki should come away with a complete understanding of the project structure, each feature, and what exactly we are building. Requirements: You write clearly, concisely, and without fluff, and can show examples of your work: guides, instructions, READMEs, how-tos, or similar materials Basic understanding of hardware, software, and development workflows (Git, commits, branches, pull requests) Able to explain complex technical topics in simple language and visualize them with flowchart sketches Strong verbal communication skills; you know how to listen, ask precise questions, and quickly extract the key points from chaotic discussions Keep communication with the community productive — without toxicity, unnecessary softness, or bureaucracy Comfortable collaborating closely with engineers and navigating technical contexts Discern useful feedback and constructive disagreement from noise and spam Value structure, logic, clarity, and information quality Genuinely interested in developer-facing products, hardware, documentation, open communities, and the build-in-public approach Proficiency in Russian and English for communication with other departments in the company and the external community Nice-to-have: Experience in DevRel, technical writing, community operations, or an editorial role Experience working with documentation, wikis, knowledge bases, or developer portals Understanding of the culture of technical communities, open-source, and hardware projects Ability to work across topics at the intersection of interfaces, electronics, product architecture, and internal development Responsibilites: Own and develop the Flipper One Developer Portal Turn the team’s internal context into clear public documentation, notes, updates, and explanations Join team calls to understand what’s actually happening in the project and maintain a complete picture of it Translate technical discussions into clear, human language without losing meaning or accuracy Moderate community comments, pull requests, and contributions Filter out spam, reduce noise, and keep discussions productive Help users understand how the portal works and how to provide useful feedback Collect signals from the community and bring them back to the team Make sure the portal stays structured, up to date, and genuinely useful What we offer: Fully remote from anywhere in the world You will be provided with all the necessary equipment for a comfortable working environment Benefits such as VHI, corporate title: Quality Manager- Manufacturing Operations
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. You will be comfortable with assessing processes and technologies to identify quality gaps and provide robust but pragmatic solutions to drive all aspects of the business in achieving the highest levels of quality and resilience. Key responsibilities Define and deliver the company quality strategy, policy and objectives, aligned to the product roadmap and growth plan. Build, lead and develop a quality team covering supplier, product, reliability, software and systems quality. Define and report quality performance to the executive team. Establish appropriate document control, change control, CAPA, internal audit, training and records processes that scale with a fast-growing fabless company. Work with PMO to embed quality gates into the new product introduction (NPI) and product lifecycle process, from concept through end of life. Own quality across the supply chain: wafer foundry, assembly and packaging, wafer and final test, PCB/PCBA and system-level contract manufacturers. Lead supplier selection, qualification, audits and ongoing performance management, including scorecards and quarterly business reviews. Work with engineering leaders to define software quality standards across drivers, firmware, compilers, SDKs and runtime. Establish release criteria, test coverage expectations, defect management and regression processes, aligned with CI/CD practice. Bring in secure development and software supply chain practice, including SBOMs and vulnerability management. Support responsible AI and AI management practice where customers ask for it, including awareness of ISO/IEC 42001. Be the senior point of contact for customer quality, audits and escalations. Lead customer RMA and complaint handling, root cause analysis and 8D responses to agreed timelines. Ensure product compliance with RoHS, REACH, WEEE, conflict minerals reporting, UKCA and CE marking, and relevant safety and EMC standards. Essential experience and skills Significant experience in quality roles in semiconductors or electronics hardware, including creating and leading a quality function or team. Direct experience managing quality through outsourced manufacturing: foundries, OSATs, test houses and/or contract manufacturers. Deep knowledge of ISO 9001 and hands-on experience building or running a certified QMS. Working knowledge of semiconductor qualification and reliability (JEDEC), failure analysis and Awareness of data centre RAS assessments and HPC system qualification and certification. Fluency in core quality tools: 8D, FMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA and root cause analysis. Experience handling customer quality escalations with large, demanding customers. Degree in electrical or electronic engineering, materials science, physics or a related discipline. Clear, confident communicator who can influence engineers, suppliers and executives, and hold partners to account. Willing to travel internationally, including to Asia and US, for supplier audits and customer quality reviews. Desirable Experience in a fabless company, particularly one bringing an initial product to volume. Background in high-performance compute, data centre, networking or AI hardware. Exposure to software quality, release management or secure development practice. Lead auditor certification (ISO 9001), Six Sigma Black Belt, or chartered status (for example CQI or IET). Experience working with suppliers in Taiwan, South Korea or US. The impact you will have You will help Fractile to makes sure every one of our suppliers builds to our standard, and that our customers receive AI hardware and software they can trust in production whilst shaping the quality culture across engineering, operations and commercial teams. title: Applied ML Technical Lead, Defence
description: Job title: Applied ML Technical Lead, Defence Location: London; full in-office working as default Start date: ASAP Reports to: CEO Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion Clearance: Must be eligible to hold UK Security Vetting Clearance SC or above (no prior clearance required) Application Deadline: 08/11/26 at 23:59 UK Time ___________________________________________________________________________ Help put frontier AI to work in Defence Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations. We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints. We're also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government. We're now looking for an Applied ML Technical Lead to help develop and deploy advanced AI capabilities for organisations operating in UK Defence and national security. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will work across machine learning development, deployment and customer-facing technical delivery. You may spend part of your time training and evaluating models on complex sensor data, and part of your time working with Defence stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape priorities and guide delivery. You will not be expected to act as a traditional project manager. Instead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML work, coordinating the people and decisions needed to turn promising research into useful operational capability. ___________________________________________________________________________ What you'll do Build ML capabilities for real Defence problems Design, build, train and evaluate machine learning models for challenging applied Defence and national security use cases. Work on problems involving complex sensor data, signal processing, pattern recognition, classification and multimodal intelligence. Develop and improve model architectures, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and inference systems. Work with real-world and synthetic datasets to improve model accuracy, robustness and generalisation. Translate research prototypes into reliable, deployable capabilities that operate within demanding technical and security constraints. Work closely with Cosine's ML research and engineering teams while taking direct ownership of technical outcomes. Lead technical delivery from prototype to deployment Own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML projects. Turn operational objectives into concrete technical goals, experiments, milestones and success measures. Coordinate work across ML researchers, software engineers, infrastructure teams and external stakeholders. Identify technical dependencies, delivery risks and blockers, and help drive them to resolution. Establish clear evaluation criteria and demonstrate progress through measurable improvements and working capabilities. Balance hands-on engineering with the planning and coordination needed to keep complex technical work moving. Work directly with Defence customers Engage with technical and operational stakeholders across the UK Defence and national security ecosystem. Understand operational challenges and identify where machine learning can make a meaningful difference. Translate customer requirements and constraints into technical objectives, datasets, experiments and delivery plans. Present technical progress, demonstrate working capabilities and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Build trusted relationships with Defence stakeholders and act as a credible technical counterpart. Help customers understand the practical considerations of integrating and deploying ML systems in their existing environments. Turn research into operational capability Help deploy ML models into real-world environments, including secure, on-premise and resource-constrained systems. Work on model optimisation, inference performance, integration and reliability. Develop robust approaches to evaluation, validation and continuous model improvement. Understand data availability, access requirements, security restrictions and deployment constraints. Establish feedback loops between operational users and Cosine's engineering teams. Ensure that what we build is not only technically impressive, but genuinely useful to the people relying on it. ___________________________________________________________________________ What we’re looking for You'll probably have a background in applied machine learning, ML engineering, research engineering or a similarly technical role, along with experience taking ownership of complex technical work. You should be comfortable: Writing production-quality Python and working with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch. Building, training, fine-tuning and evaluating machine learning models. Working with complex datasets, designing experiments and interpreting model performance. Understanding the trade-offs between model performance, compute requirements, latency and deployment constraints. Working with engineering infrastructure, including Git, containers, Linux and GPU compute. Taking technical ownership of projects with multiple stakeholders, uncertain requirements and evolving priorities. Communicating technical concepts clearly to researchers, engineers, senior stakeholders and operational users. Moving between model development, customer discussions and delivery planning without losing technical depth. Making sound technical judgements, prioritising effectively and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear. You don't need to have worked in Defence before. You do need to be excited by the opportunity to apply advanced ML to difficult, consequential real-world problems. Nice to have Existing UK security clearance, such as SC or DV, or previous experience working in secure Defence environments. Experience with signal processing, time-series data, sensor fusion, representation learning or machine learning applied to complex real-world datasets. Experience with foundation models, multimodal learning or advanced model training and post-training techniques. Experience deploying ML models to edge devices or constrained compute environments. Familiarity with UK Defence procurement, technical assurance or the national security landscape. Experience leading technical workstreams or working as a technical lead on customer-facing ML projects. ___________________________________________________________________________ What success looks like In your first three months, we would expect you to: Become the technical lead for a major applied Defence ML programme, with responsibility for its day-to-day technical progress. Build strong working relationships with Cosine's ML researchers, engineers and key Defence customer stakeholders. Develop a clear understanding of the existing models, datasets, technical architecture and operational objectives. title: Frontend Engineering Lead
description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. What We're Looking For We're looking for a Frontend Lead Engineer to own the front end at Omnea. You'll work across every product team. You'll own the design system, own the front-end architecture, and set the standard for how we build interfaces. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple. The front end has to scale with it. Getting this right is the difference between software people tolerate and software people actually like using. What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team? Join a Skilled Team. Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers and product designers from top technology businesses and startups. Own the Design System. You'll own our design system outright: components, patterns, tokens, documentation, and adoption. You'll partner closely with Design to turn intent into reusable, high-quality primitives. Own the Front-End Architecture. Deployment strategy, performance, build tooling, and the conventions everyone else follows. You'll set the direction rather than inherit it, working alongside the engineers and designers closest to each surface rather than owning it in isolation. Leverage Across Every Team. You'll work with all of our engineering teams on their most front-end-heavy projects. The work you do multiplies across the whole org. A Real Design Partnership. Every cross-functional team at Omnea has a dedicated Product Manager and Product Designer. You'll be the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships, and the person designers come to when they want to know what's possible. Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript everywhere, React and Next.js on the front end, and Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, so you can refactor the design system without fear. Behind it sits Postgres and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions, with Datadog for observability. AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. Continuous Delivery. We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops. Collaboration and Autonomy. We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems. Customers at the Center. We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value. About You You're deep in React. You've built complex, production React applications and you understand the framework properly, not just the API surface. Rendering behaviour, state, performance, and where things break at scale. You've owned front-end infrastructure. Rendering strategies, build tooling, bundle performance, and the architectural decisions underneath a large application. You've built or owned a design system. Layout, styling architecture, and building interfaces that hold up across breakpoints, themes, and edge cases. You treat accessibility and motion as part of the craft rather than a checklist at the end. You're a strong engineer first. Your depth and your interest sit in the front end, and that's the point of this role. But you're fluent in TypeScript generally and comfortable working beyond the browser when a problem calls for it. You're motivated by impact. You care about what your work actually achieves, not just how it's built. You thrive with the autonomy to make meaningful decisions and take real ownership of outcomes. You're comfortable with ambiguity. This role is new. Its shape will be partly yours to define, and you're happy tackling problems without a predefined solution, backed by an experienced team. title: Senior International Sales Recruiter, UK/EMEA
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. "At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you." – Alicia Strait , VP of Talent, TRM Labs As TRM expands across EMEA and other global markets, our ability to hire the right sellers, compliance experts, and go-to-market talent in-region determines how fast our blockchain intelligence reaches the institutions and agencies fighting illicit finance worldwide. As an International Sales Recruiter , you'll own high-priority searches across EMEA and beyond — Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and broader business roles — partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent leadership to define strategy, map regional markets, engage passive candidates, and drive high-quality hiring decisions with speed and precision. Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of the hires you make across TRM's international business functions. The impact you'll have: Own full-cycle recruiting for international roles across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other functions. Act as a strategic talent partner to hiring managers, including advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, sourcing strategy, and close approach. Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional talent across EMEA and other global markets. Develop regional talent maps across priority markets that include high-performing companies, competitive talent, referral networks, and specialized candidate communities. Create an exceptional candidate experience where every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles. Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time. Drive urgency and decision quality through clear calibration, structured feedback, and timely hiring decisions. Continuously improve international recruiting including intake quality, scorecard alignment, sourcing strategy, debrief rigor, and offer execution. Partner cross-functionally with Talent, People, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to navigate international hiring considerations and keep searches moving. What we're looking for: 7+ years of recruiting experience, with strong experience supporting international sales hiring in high-growth technology companies. Proven success hiring across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other business functions. Strong knowledge of EMEA talent markets, with the ability to adapt strategy by region, function, and candidate profile. Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, candidate assessment, and closing. The ability to quickly understand complex business roles across GTM, compliance, marketing, and operations. Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality and translate them into action. Exceptional stakeholder management that includes building trust, influencing hiring managers, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor. Excellent written and verbal communication, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for stakeholders. High ownership, autonomy, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, specialized, business-critical searches. The ability to operate effectively in a remote, globally distributed environment with strong overlap across EMEA and U.S. business hours. About the team: Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates. We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together. We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting. We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration. Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review. Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen. Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled. Our Onboarding Process: Within your first 30 days , you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions. Within your first 60 days , you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds. Within your first 90 days , you’ll have made 2–3 hires . The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role: Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only The estimated base salary range for this role is $153,000 - $172,000. Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan. Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. title: Product Designer
description: <p><strong>About CreativeX</strong></p> <p>CreativeX is B2B SaaS technology platform that helps global marketing teams make smarter creative decisions and elevate creative expression through the clarity of data. Our technology powers creative decision-making at some of the biggest brands in the world, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, and more.</p> <p>We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance.</p> <p>That's because multiple studies have shown that the "Creative" itself is responsible for half of sales lift online, higher than reach, targeting, brand, & recency combined. But creative impact has always been the least analysed and least understood component of a complex set of marketing variables.</p> <p>This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift.</p> <p>Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data.</p> <p><strong>Product Design Team</strong></p> <p>As a Product Designer, you'll help shape the next generation of the CreativeX platform, taking problems from discovery through to shipped experiences across defined areas of the product. You'll be the design lead in a product trio alongside a Product Manager and an Engineering Lead, owning whether users want what we build and whether they can figure out how to use it, while sharing discovery, outcomes and trade-offs with your partners. CreativeX is a complex product with rich data, multiple user types and increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities, and as AI increases the volume and speed of creative production, you'll make that complexity work for marketers, helping them measure performance fast, find the patterns behind what's working and see whether their full set of ads is delivering the strategy. Our roadmap is framed as problems to solve, not screens to make, so we expect you to bring a point of view. Product Design is a small, hands-on team in a scale-up: you'll be trusted with real ownership early, and this hire is an important step in growing the team.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own design for defined product areas, from understanding the problem through to working with Product and Engineering to ship the right experience</li> <li>Get close to marketers and creative teams through customer conversations, research and usability testing, using what you learn to inform design decisions</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering in discovery CreativeX</li> <li>Use and extend our design system, creating and documenting patterns and components so they're implemented consistently</li> <li>Raise the quality bar through strong interaction and visual design craft, and by giving and receiving feedback in critiques</li> <li>Learn from what you ship, using customer feedback, product data and research to improve the experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p> <p><em>In your first 90 days</em></p> <ul> <li>Learn the CreativeX platform, our customers and our design system, and work as the design lead in your product trio</li> <li>Take ownership of a defined product area and ship, or get build-ready, your first piece of work</li> <li>Contribute to our AI-powered product work and add to or improve patterns in our design system</li> <li>Join customer conversations and use what you hear to shape your design decisions</li> </ul> <p><em>In your first year</em></p> <ul> <li>Own design for one or more product areas, taking work from discovery through to launch with little direction</li> <li>Ship work you can point to, using customer feedback and product data to show whether it solved the problem</li> <li>Help build out new parts of our design system and make the product feel more coherent across areas</li> <li>Shape how design works at CreativeX as the team grows, including supporting newer designers</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>3–5 years of product design experience, with a portfolio that shows how you framed problems, explored options, made trade-offs and learned from what shipped</li> <li>Strong interaction and visual design craft, confident in Figma, prototyping and design systems, and familiar with Slack and Linear</li> <li>Experience using research, usability testing and customer feedback to inform design decisions</li> <li>A systems mindset and the ability to make complex information, workflows and data easy to understand</li> <li>Clear, collaborative communication: you challenge ideas constructively, take feedback well and know when to ship and learn</li> <li>Experience working closely with Product and Engineering in a product trio or small team, with real ownership</li> <li><em>Nice to have:</em> B2B SaaS, data-heavy or analytics products; marketing, advertising or martech; AI-powered products; mentoring junior designers; scale-up experience</li> </ul> <p>At CreativeX, we encourage applicants of all backgrounds and identities to apply for roles that align with their own interests and career trajectory. If you fit the description above and see yourself in this role, we would love to see your application! <em>Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time.</em></p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <p>🍎 Private Medical Insurance and Health Cash Plan<br>✈️ Generous time off + bank holidays<br>📚 Education budget to be used for individual learning experiences or grouped with your team for joint learning<br>🧘 Annual subscription to Calm and Headspace for your mental wellbeing<br>🎟 Monthly coaching to talk to a trained professional about career goals, relationships, and personal development<br>💵 Competitive salary including stock options, as we believe that everyone should have a stake in the business<br>🍼 4-month full pay parenting leave for all employees who have been with the company for one (1) year</p> <p><em><strong>CreativeX provides equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees.</strong></em></p> <p><em>As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, CreativeX conducts standard right to work and background checks on all potential employees. Background checks are conducted via a secure third party application and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.</em></p> <p></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
