title: 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer
description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role You’ll join our Research Team in London as a 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer — working at both ends of the pipeline, from cutting-edge academic research to shipping directly to customers. Our team builds the reconstruction technology that turns casually captured or domain-specific imagery into high-fidelity 3D reconstructions: everything from Structure-from-Motion through 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward models, and generative models. We’ve shipped 360 splatting to consumers and enterprise customers, developed the splatting tech that runs on phones, and published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH — more often than not, our papers end up in production. Algorithm Development — Design, implement, and evaluate novel algorithms across 3D reconstruction, neural scene representations, 3D Gaussian Splatting, SfM, meshing, geometric deep learning, feed-forward models, generative models, and spatial foundation models. Research-to-Production — Collaborate with research scientists and engineers to transition promising ideas into customer-facing products — working directly with real capture conditions, real hardware constraints, and real customers on short turnarounds. Large-Scale Experimentation — Build and run large-scale experiments and benchmarking frameworks to rigorously validate and advance new methods. Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration — Partner with world-class researchers in CV, ML, graphics, and robotics to advance large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, and geospatial foundation models. Rapid Prototyping — Implement and iterate on state-of-the-art methods for both academic publishing and production deployment, delivering working prototypes to enterprise customers with speed and quality. What You’ll Bring PhD in Computer Vision, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field — or equivalent demonstrated research experience in industry. A strong research track record in 3D computer vision: reconstruction, depth estimation, novel view synthesis, SfM, SLAM, or closely related areas. A meaningful publication record at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or equivalent). Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch. Evidence that you can carry an idea from research into something real — a shipped feature, a production pipeline, a widely used open-source release, or similar. The independence to drive research projects from idea generation through experimentation, publication, and handoff. Nice to Have Experience with classical reconstruction tooling (COLMAP or similar). C++ or CUDA experience, and a feel for performance and on-device constraints. Experience with traditional 3D techniques — meshing, texturing, or bringing modern geometry or generative representations into native 3D. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Location & Work Model This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office. title: Senior Social Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy  </strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named <a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-brings-home-network-year-2026-cannes-lions-international-festival-creativity">Network of the Year</a> at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.ogilvy.com/ideas/ogilvy-tops-warc-effective-100-creative-100-4th-straight-year" data-outlook-id="e2c78315-ff05-4544-925f-9288319dea2c">ranks</a><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.ogilvy.com/" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="39833259-880d-4fd8-930f-0d84b1c14850">Ogilvy.com</a>, and follow us on<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="735e393e-6e8a-4ca8-804a-74f1bd8166b6">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ogilvy" data-outlook-id="d10960ce-761b-48c5-81d5-0a7c4cc6013a">X</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="92ffcb70-6ca7-4d9a-88d5-c130e36e6c4f"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.facebook.com/ogilvy/" data-outlook-id="3bd2010d-00a2-401b-8cfb-7e8c24deac52"> Facebook.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Senior Social Strategist</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Department:</strong> Social Strategy</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> London</p> <p><strong>Contract type:</strong> 12-month Fixed Term Contract</p> <p><strong>Full Time/Part time:</strong> Full time</p> <p><strong>Reporting into:</strong> Head of Social Strategy</p> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong> </p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity at Ogilvy to play a key role in elevating our social capabilities for 2026 and beyond, helping us redefine our social and content offer and realize our new global ambition of ‘building social brands’. Ogilvy is seeking an experienced <strong>Senior Strategist</strong> who will sit within our Social Strategy team. They will be responsible for collaborating closely with clients to gain a deep understanding of their businesses, target audiences, and brand values and developing bold creative strategies that answer their unique challenges. You’ll take full ownership of key workstreams and use your deep social knowledge to develop innovation strategic solutions. You’ll also benefit from being part of Ogilvy’s wider strategy community where you’ll work alongside - and learn from - specialised strategists in PR, influence, brand and experience, as well as experts in behavioural science and consulting.</p> <p>As a mentor and a leader, you’ll help guide and support junior team members in their professional growth and strategic development, because you know what great social strategy looks like. You’ll advocate for diversity of thought and champion inclusive approaches from the team, because you know that strategy can come in lots of different flavours and a great insight can be found anywhere.  </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic development and execution:</strong> Lead the development of social and content strategies, playbooks, workshops, and measurement frameworks for clients (with guidance from the team lead on bigger projects). Adapt the strategic output based on client need (e.g. tissue decks, strategic responses, paths forward, workshops, etc). Define the brands’ role of social and create messaging frameworks with clear content pillars, all laddering back to the overall brand vision and supported by social intelligence data. Build trust and rapport with clients and colleagues and sell them on your strong strategic thinking.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Creative briefing: </strong>Develop strategic creative territories and write clear briefs for the creative team to explore them. Articulate social-first creative ideas to clients and help them understand how/ why they work.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Insight mining and creative problem solving:</strong>. Intuitively understand client challenges and leverage business data to get to the core of the problem. Uncover unexpected insights from a diverse range of sources to help shape your social communication strategies. Interpret reporting data to suggest improvements to campaign or organic social performance.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Impactful storyteller and engaging presenter: </strong>Inspire internal and external stakeholders on the strategic opportunities of social and present narratives in compelling and memorable ways. Design and lead workshops/ client presentations and act as an ideas catalyst and strategic partner for clients, asking insightful questions to get clients thinking differently about their brand on social.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Leading and mentoring junior team members:</strong>. Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, fostering their growth and leading by example. Contribute to Ogilvy's culture of excellence, innovation, and impactful creativity. Know what a great social strategy looks like and help upskill team members on that thinking.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Thinking social first, not social only: </strong>Possess a deep understanding of social best practises, trends, tools and technologies and apply this knowledge to clients to enhance their campaign performance. Share industry insights and best practices to inspire internal teams and clients. Understand and articulate how social works within the larger media ecosystem and within the client’s broader campaign/ business goals.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Collaborating cross functionally:</strong> Think laterally about how to uncover unique insights by working closely with our in-house Marketing Science partners to test hypotheses and get to the right answers. Ensure alignment of campaigns with brand strategies by collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Contribute to new business pitches and proposals, infusing industry insights and creative ideas.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Experience designing tailored strategic social plans that address diverse business goals, incorporating latest social trends and best practises.</li> <li>Relentlessly curious about social, with a deep knowledge of social trends, platforms and aesthetics. A proactive approach to staying updated with industry trends, tools, and technologies.</li> <li>Experience defining the role of social for brands and creating messaging frameworks for brands with clear content territories/ pillars.</li> <li>Experience in creative agencies or equivalent environments. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects and priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members. Commitment to fostering inclusivity and embracing innovative approaches to strategy development.</li> <li>Effective presentation skills to convey ideas and strategies convincingly. Ability to lead presentations/ workshops confidently.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate effectively with XFN teams and with colleagues from diverse disciplines and backgrounds.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>How we help you Thrive:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day  </li> <li>Bupa Healthcare</li> <li>Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave</li> <li>We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm</li> <li>A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure</li> <li>Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year </li> <li>Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme</li> <li>Life Assurance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. </p> <p>We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. </p> <p>Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></p> <p>If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at ----- Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer – AI-Native Software Development
description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>We just unveiled JetBrains Central,  a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance.</p> <p>JetBrains Central provides three core capabilities:<br><strong>Governance and control: </strong>Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the <a href="http://console.jetbrains.cloud/">JetBrains Central Console</a>.<br><strong>Agent execution infrastructure: </strong>Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments.<br><strong>Agent optimization and context:</strong> Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools.</p> <p>Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development.</p> <p>You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development.</p> <p>This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems.</p> <p>This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development.</p> <p>You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms.</li> <li>Help organizations transition from ad-hoc AI experimentation to governed AI-native development workflows.</li> <li>Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls.</li> <li>Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns.</li> <li>Design sustainable AI adoption strategies, including usage controls and cost visibility across multiple model providers.</li> <li>Integrate our cloud-based agent execution layer, allowing AI agents to run securely and at scale.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with JetBrains product teams to shape the platform based on real-world deployments and customer feedback.</li> <li>Create delivery frameworks and train JetBrains partners to deliver the desired scope of service.</li> <li>Mentor and support other Forward Deployed Engineers, sharing architectural expertise and helping to scale the team’s deployment practices.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will thrive in this role if you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A consultant at heart who can communicate effectively with both engineers and technical leadership.</li> <li>Able to see the whole picture of the software development lifecycle across developer tools, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud systems.</li> <li>Experienced at integrating complex software systems into enterprise environments.</li> <li>Curious about the future of AI agents and AI-native software development.</li> <li>Comfortable working with early adopters and overcoming ambiguous technical challenges.</li> <li>Motivated to mentor other engineers and contribute to building a new technical discipline.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in software-related projects, ideally in a customer-facing or consulting environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with Java or Python.</li> <li>Experience building or integrating developer platforms, infrastructure systems, or software solutions.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern development workflows (CI/CD, developer environments, internal developer platforms, etc.).</li> <li>Experience working directly with customers or technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate in fast-evolving technical environments.</li> <li>Ability and desire to travel to meet customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>These would be a plus, but are not blockers</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with industry-specific solutions (fintech, telco, retail, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with AI/LLM platforms, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development tools.<br>Experience in solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering roles.</li> <li>Familiarity with the JetBrains ecosystem or developer productivity tooling.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KP1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the <a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/privacy/privacy-recruitment/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a></em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A. We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier. If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place. About the role Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality. We're looking for Platform Engineers who treat the platform as a product, with every engineer at Attio as its customer. You'll own the infrastructure, tooling and pipelines that let the rest of engineering ship quickly and safely, and you'll be accountable for keeping all of it reliable, fast and cost-effective as we scale. What you'll do Build and evolve our platform infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP), so every environment is reproducible, version-controlled and auditable. Own our CI/CD pipelines end-to-end, making builds, tests and deploys fast, reliable and secure for every engineer at Attio. Own our observability stack - metrics, logging and distributed tracing - as the foundation of an exceptional reliability culture. Define and hold SLOs for latency, availability and error rates, and manage capacity to stay comfortably inside them. Lead incident response: triage and resolve complex production issues, then run blameless post-mortems and ship the fixes as code. Partner with product engineering teams to remove manual toil and shorten the path from writing code to running it in production. What you'll bring Hands-on experience operating production systems with an SRE mindset: SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction and blameless post-mortems. Excellent knowledge of modern cloud architectures (either GCP or AWS), including networking, IAM and managed services. description: WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world's most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and high growth environment, join us and be part of a team that's transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE ROLE This is an opportunity for an experienced finance business partner to join our Commercial Finance team, based in our London office. You will own the COGS profit and loss line (bank fees and hosting costs) and the unit economics across the cost base, partnering closely with Banking, Infrastructure and Engineering to control and improve margins. You will lead monthly performance commentary and the annual planning process for the cost base, working closely with Accounting and the wider business. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES COGS & Unit Economics: Own the COGS P&L line end to end (bank fees and hosting costs) and the unit economics across the cost base, including cost per transaction, feeding into merchant pricing models and investment cases. Banking Partnerships: Partner with the VP Banking Relationships on banking partnerships, driving down banking costs and identifying bank routing efficiencies, including modelling the aggregator versus direct integration breakeven. Cloud Economics: Partner with the VP Infrastructure on cloud cost analysis, ensuring infrastructure spend scales efficiently with usage. Engineering Partnership: Partner with the VP Engineering on capacity allocation and capitalised development project decisions, day to day rather than at a distance. Performance Commentary: Own monthly performance commentary on COGS, working with Accounting to confirm reported numbers are accurate and with the business to understand what is driving the trajectory. Annual Planning: Lead the annual planning process for the cost base, including banking negotiation support, bank routing efficiencies and cloud or hosting optimisation as key initiatives, then support the business through the year to track performance against plan and course correct. QUALIFICATIONS The successful candidate will have: 5+ years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance or a similar finance business partnering role; Strong stakeholder management experience, comfortable partnering with finance and non finance teams, including engineering, banking and infrastructure partners; Strong analytical capability, with experience building financial models and business cases; Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for modelling and analysis; Experience improving processes and ways of working, including bringing automation into finance reporting or planning, is a plus. title: Senior Front Office Support Engineer
description: <p><strong>The Role<br></strong>We are seeking an experienced and proactive Front Office Support Engineer to join our expanding global Front Office Support and Automation team in London. The Front Office Support team is embedded within our Portfolio Management and Trading teams, providing monitoring, maintenance, and support of our most business-critical systems. You will be responsible for solving complex problems for our investment professionals and stakeholders and will serve as the first point of contact for troubleshooting any issues with our trading platform.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role interesting <br></strong>The Front Office Support Engineer will focus on providing critical support for our EMEA-based Fundamental Equity and Tactical Trading Portfolio Managers, Traders and Analysts. You will manage a dynamic workload and gain exposure to many interesting facets of the firm, including but not limited to:</p> <ul> <li>Front-row seat to the markets: You will sit on the trading floor, embedded with our Portfolio Management teams, with real-time exposure to multi-asset strategies and decision-making.</li> <li>Impact from day one: Resolving a production incident or supporting a Portfolio Manager has an immediate effect on PnL.</li> <li>Build and run: We don't just troubleshoot, we optimise. You'll have the autonomy to identify repetitive pain points and work with partner teams to automate and evolve our processes.</li> <li>Global perspective: Follow-the-sun coverage means close collaboration with support teams in the US and APAC, so you'll learn and share best practices globally.<br></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Incident ownership: Triage, diagnose, and resolve real-time trading issues across our Order Management System (OMS)/Execution Management System (EMS), Bloomberg, and proprietary trading and execution tools/systems.</li> <li>Stakeholder management: Act as the technology "first responder" - our liaison and primary bridge between our front office users (traders and Portfolio Managers) and core engineering teams, translating trading requests into actionable technical work.</li> <li>Service reliability: Maintain and evolve our monitoring, alerting, and post-incident review processes, and help drive a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Project execution: Lead projects from ideation and requirements gathering through to production. </li> </ul> <p><u><strong>What You’ll Bring<br></strong></u><strong>What you need </strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of financial services experience supporting traders and Portfolio Managers (ideally at a hedge fund, investment bank, or electronic market-maker).</li> <li>Experience working with Order Management Systems (OMS), Execution Management Systems (EMS), and Portfolio Management Systems (PMS) trading stacks.</li> <li>Experience supporting front office vendor trading systems (e.g. Portware, Enfusion, Neovest) - Knowledge of equities, futures, FX, and/or options trading strategies.</li> <li>Working knowledge of trading workflows, FIX, market data vendors (Bloomberg, LSEG/Refinitiv), and broker algos - Technical skills including SQL, FIX Protocol and Excel/VBA.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication - ability to translate and explain complex issues to non-technical users.</li> <li>Ability to maintain composure under pressure, take initiative in problem-solving, and identify root causes</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership and a track record of delivering results.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven AI tooling experience - Scripting experience with Python.</li> <li>Strong business analysis and project management skills.</li> <li>Exposure to APIs - Derivatives and valuation experience - you understand Greeks, pricing models, and how traders interpret them, or have experience supporting systems that perform these calculations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we are </strong><br>Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income.<br><strong>Our Culture </strong><br>At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.</p> <p>#LI-TJ1</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description: <h3>United Kingdom (Remote)</h3> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees: while driving measurable ROI.</p> <p>We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether you’re engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.</p> <p>Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with your marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stack and is powered by a world-class team with hubs in New York, London, and Lisbon.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for an exceptional Senior Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst to help us understand performance, plan for the future, and make better business decisions. Reporting to our CFO, you'll own core planning and forecasting, turn data into clear insights and recommendations, and work directly with leaders and teams across the business to improve decisions and execution.</p> <p>Our business model uniquely combines SaaS and prepaid customer wallets with a global gift marketplace, branded merchandise, and international fulfilment. That creates complex planning and analysis across recurring and transactional revenue, margins, cash and wallet dynamics, and multiple entities and currencies.</p> <p>Your impact will extend well beyond building models and reporting numbers. You'll bring ideas and perspective, challenge assumptions, solve problems, and help turn analysis into action. You'll be equally adept at getting into the details and stepping back to understand what the numbers mean for the business.</p> <p>You'll work across NetSuite, Salesforce, DealHub, and our reporting tools, with a strong focus on automation and AI, helping build an FP&A function that is insightful, efficient, and closely connected to the business.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the consolidated operating model and rolling P&L and cash forecasts across entities and revenue streams, including customer wallet balances.</li> <li>Own the annual budget and quarterly forecasting process, with clear analysis of performance, variances, risks, and opportunities.</li> <li>Work directly with leaders and budget holders across the business to understand performance, challenge assumptions, solve problems, and drive work through completion.</li> <li>Prepare monthly management reporting and board and investor materials, turning financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations.</li> <li>Analyse unit economics and margin by revenue stream to support pricing, deal, investment, and other commercial decisions.</li> <li>Define and maintain consistent definitions for key business metrics, including ARR, retention, and margin by revenue stream, ensuring they reconcile to reported financials each month.</li> <li>Calculate sales commissions and support the design and review of commission plans.</li> <li>Provide transaction analysis to support tax decisions, including VAT registrations and disclosures, and US sales tax thresholds.</li> <li>Maintain accurate dashboards and self-service performance reporting for budget holders and leadership, partnering with our business systems team on data and integrations.</li> <li>Improve and automate forecasting, reporting, and variance analysis, using AI and other tools to increase the speed and quality of our In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com</p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>This is a fantastic opportunity where we are looking for a Commercial Finance Manager to become part of the WPP Media UK Commercial team, reporting to the Commercial Business Partner. This is a key role, with an overriding objective to partner with the Commercial Business Partner and the business, whilst fostering a growth mindset to help drive KPI’s.</p> <p><strong> </strong><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide commercial insight and performance analysis across WPP Media Solutions, supporting strategic decision-making and business growth.</li> <li>Support the development of commercial and financial models for new solutions, and client opportunities.</li> <li>Support key stakeholders in driving client adoption of Solutions and increasing share of wallet across our client base.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pipeline & Revenue Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage and monitor sales pipeline through Salesforce, including targeting and revenue tracking.</li> <li>Analyse pipeline conversion trends and develop models to improve revenue predictability.</li> <li>Collaborate with commercial teams to validate assumptions, identify risks and opportunities.</li> <li>Support FP&A on revenue and net sales assumptions.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong>Margin & Profitability Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver analysis on net sales performance and client profitability across the business.</li> <li>Identify key commercial trends and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.</li> <li>Investigate and resolve discrepancies within revenue and sales reporting.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pricing, Trading & Commercial Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the development and implementation of pricing strategies across clients and solutions.</li> <li>Monitor delivery against commercial value agreements and trading commitments.</li> <li>Analyse the impact of pricing, value delivery, and cost changes on net sales margins.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Commercial Governance & Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct commercial due diligence for new client opt-in requirements</li> <li>Monitor net sales performance against bonus and incentive targets (QPP).</li> <li>Act as a key link between Commercial and Finance teams, ensuring commercial terms and charging methodologies are accurately applied across all revenue streams.</li> <li>Provide ad hoc commercial analysis and strategic support to relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Support and educate wider agency teams on commercial finance processes, principles, and best practices.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Qualified accountant or equivalent</li> <li>4 years high level of accuracy in their output</li> <li>Ability to work under pressure and to tight timelines</li> <li>Highly proficient with Excel (Advanced excel skills)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. title: Business Recruiter
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰£58,400 - £79,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Business Hiring team⭐</strong></p> <p>We’re a small but mighty team, working on all the roles that are <strong><em>not</em></strong> Tech (Engineering, Product, Data or Design) and <strong><em>not</em></strong> in the world of Customer Service. In other companies, this is sometimes known as Corporate Functions. We touch on a huge variety of roles and so we talk to lots of different types of people every day. We're looking for support to boost our hiring efforts as the business scales.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <p><em>You’ll work with Hiring Managers to structure and run great hiring processes.</em></p> <ul> <li>Our hiring managers are often busy team leads and executives. They’ll need your help to identify what skills they’re looking for and how best to assess these. You’ll be confident challenging their thinking and asking the right questions to figure this out. You’ll own everything about the hiring process from beginning to end, and be skilled at convincing candidates to join us.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll care deeply about diversity and inclusiveness, and giving candidates an amazing experience</em></p> <ul> <li>We want to go the extra mile to make sure that every applicant to every job feels valued, respected and never wavers in their support for Monzo, whatever the outcome of their application. You’ll know where to find the right candidates from a range of backgrounds and have ideas about how to make sure they feel welcome at Monzo. And once we’ve decided we want to hire someone, you’ll move mountains in the background to make it an effortless, pleasant process, and keep that excitement burning.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll love sourcing and be great at spotting great talent in CVs</em></p> <ul> <li>You’ll be great at sourcing passive candidates yourself, and thinking about how to get the best people interested in Monzo. You’ll be comfortable managing large volumes of applications and picking out those that best fit our requirements.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll be passionate about making processes work better.</em></p> <ul> <li>We constantly refine our hiring processes to make them simpler and more effective. You’ll use data to work out what’s going well and where things could be better, and share your findings with other members of the hiring team so we can all improve.</li> </ul> <p><em>You might already have a specialist area but you’ll be comfortable working on any role</em></p> <ul> <li>We don’t mind if you’re a generalist recruiter, or if you already have a specialism, as long as you’re initially happy getting stuck into hiring any role that needs you. You’ll work closely with other members of the hiring team to solve company-wide hiring problems, share what you already know and learn from their experiences. As the team builds out, you’ll be able to continue specialising as an individual contributor, or explore development into management or leadership.</li> </ul> <p><em>You’ll be data-driven and comfortable running your own reports</em></p> <ul> <li>You’ll be comfortable using data to support your suggestions and observations within a hiring process.You’ll actively bring useful insights to your hiring managers to help them make informed decisions on process improvements and candidates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve got experience recruiting multiple roles, possibly in a range of disciplines</li> <li>You care deeply about inclusiveness and diversity</li> <li>You love sourcing and pride yourself on your resourcefulness</li> <li>You’re empathetic, adaptable and respectful of candidates’ needs and priorities</li> <li>You can adapt your approach to work with a range of stakeholders with different needs</li> <li>You can tell whether somebody has the skills we’re looking for, without relying on previous job titles or qualifications</li> </ul> <p>It would be great if:</p> <ul> <li>You've got experience recruiting in-house at a startup or scale-up</li> <li>You've worked directly with executives</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £58,400 - £79,000 salary range ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>A recruiter call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>A loop interview with members of the hiring team and a key stakeholder</li> <li>Final feedback and reverse interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-DH1 </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: New Business Director [Global]

Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth

About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates If you want to be the person leadership turns to for an honest read of the business, and to see your analysis change real product and commercial decisions, this role is for you. What you'll do Shape commercial decisions Own the SumUp Consumer KPI framework end to end — defining which metrics matter, how they're measured and how they connect customer behaviour to commercial outcomes. Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth. Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets. Drive product decisions Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value. Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact. title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Role As a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer, you will lead the design and operation of security controls that protect our internal networks, workforce identities, endpoints and corporate systems. You will be working globally with security teams across US, EU and APAC, delivering against our goals and objectives - reducing risk and maturing controls. As a Senior, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will define technical direction, make architectural decisions, and deliver complex security initiatives end-to-end. You will be expected to balance risk reduction with usability, ensuring controls are robust without impeding employee productivity. This role focuses on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint security (EDR), Network Security, logging and detection engineering, and secure SaaS enablement. You will work closely with IT, Legal, Privacy, Engineering and business stakeholders to embed security as a default practice across the organisation. Security controls will be aligned to recognised frameworks such as the CIS Critical Security Controls and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF). Key Responsibilities Architecture & Control Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain core corporate security controls, including phishing-resistant MFA, Just-In-Time (JIT) access, strict role-based access control (RBAC), zero-trust architectures, device and identity bound proofing and modern network isolation. Tooling Ownership: Serve as the technical owner for a broad suite of corporate security systems, managing deployments, configurations, and API integrations for tools across the corporate environment. Technical Leadership: Lead and implement the technical strategy for Endpoint Device trust, Data Loss Prevention, Intellectual property storage, and SaaS application security. Alongside wider corporate security technical controls. Automation & Engineering: Write scripts and build tools to automate security workflows, incident response tasks, and audit evidence collection for compliance. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with IT and business operations to integrate security tools into everyday workflows. Guide non-security teams to adopt secure baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) as standard practice. Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, and help improve the team's engineering standards. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years' experience in Security Engineering, Corporate Security, Detection & Response, or a related field. Hands-on experience administering IAM platforms (e.g. Okta, GoogleWorkspace). Deep hands-on experience with GoogleWorkspace products Practical hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (e.g AWS, GCP) Relevant and practical experience with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g Terraform) Experience implementing modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect). Practical experience securing macOS, Windows and Linux endpoints using MDM and EDR/XDR tooling. Experience operating SIEM and/or SOAR platforms and tuning detection logic. Experience with vulnerability management and patch governance. Ability to write production-quality automation scripts. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives. Desirable Skills Experience with SASE or Zero Trust Network Access platforms. Hands on experience deploying applications into K8 and Docker environments Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS security governance. Advanced detection engineering or SOAR playbook development. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits. Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, GIAC). title: Manager, Applied AI Architects - Digital Natives, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>As Manager of the EMEA Digital Natives Applied AI Architecture team, you'll drive adoption of frontier AI across Europe's fastest-growing technology companies: SaaS scale-ups, fintechs, marketplaces, consumer platforms, and developer-tooling businesses. Your team makes Anthropic's products (Claude Enterprise, Claude Code, and the Claude API) successful in production. They address each customer's business needs and technical requirements, and they meet the high bar for reliability and safety that these companies' own users expect.</p> <p>You'll lead and grow a team of Applied AI Architects across EMEA. You'll set the pre-sales standards for the segment, develop each person on the team, and act as a technical lead on some of Anthropic's most strategic European accounts. You'll work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to help digital-native companies build Claude into their core products and platforms. You'll also explain complex solutions clearly to both engineers and executives.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Manage and mentor a distributed team of Applied AI Architects, providing technical guidance and career development</p> </li> <li> <p>Set goals and run performance reviews that drive growth and output</p> </li> <li> <p>Work directly with a small number of the highest-value EMEA digital-native customers on their AI adoption strategy, including:</p> <ul> <li> <p>use case scoping</p> </li> <li> <p>building technical champions</p> </li> <li> <p>running POCs</p> </li> </ul> </li> <li> <p>Partner with EMEA GTM leadership to understand customer requirements and co-build segment strategy</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the technical side of pre-sales, making sure your team delivers compelling demos and validates customer ROI</p> </li> <li> <p>Guide customers through EMEA-specific technical and procurement requirements, including GDPR, the EU AI Act, and data residency</p> </li> <li> <p>Align cross-functional stakeholders across time zones and regions to drive business outcomes</p> </li> <li> <p>Travel regularly across EMEA for executive sessions, technical workshops, and relationship building</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead the vision and execution of solutions that use our latest models for tech-forward use cases</p> </li> <li> <p>Represent Anthropic in the European tech community through conferences, meetups, webinars, and technical content</p> </li> <li> <p>Stay current on AI/ML developments and the competitive landscape in the European tech sector</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>7+ years of experience as a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or in a similar pre-sales technical role</p> </li> <li> <p>3+ years of experience managing pre-sales or technical GTM teams, ideally across multiple EMEA markets</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience selling to and working with digital-native companies, such as vertical or horizontal SaaS, consumer tech, fintech, PaaS, or developer platforms</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with how European tech companies evaluate and procure technology, including security reviews, DPAs, and regulatory scrutiny</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep technical proficiency with API integrations, production LLM use cases, and AI-powered system architecture</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with prompt engineering and LLM evaluation, plus working knowledge of how large language models are built and operate</p> </li> <li> <p>A strong grasp of developer tooling, SDKs, and the integration patterns common in modern software companies</p> </li> <li> <p>Enjoyment of building foundational teams in unstructured, fast-moving environments</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong executive presence and the ability to build deep trust with CTOs, engineering leaders, and technical founders</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent communication, collaboration, and coaching skills</p> </li> <li> <p>The ability to make ambiguous problems clear and find principles that carry across scenarios</p> </li> <li> <p>A passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial, with a habit of thinking beyond past checklists and playbooks</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is title: Partnerships Manager
description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. Due to ongoing growth and demand, we’re looking for a Partnerships Manager to build relationships and lead materials design engagements with potential partners in Europe. Early stage, big market. Materials are a trillion-dollar problem, and most R&D organizations are only starting to use AI. You shape it from day one. You'll help decide who we work with, how we go to market and which partnerships make it grow. What You Will Do Build the pipeline Identify and reach R&D, materials and chemicals teams at US industrial companies that can benefit from direct access to our AI and data. Own your pipeline end to end, from the first conversation to a signed agreement. Use your network and market knowledge to open doors in key innovation hubs such as the Bay Area, Boston, Texas and the Research Triangle. Close and grow partnerships Understand each team's materials challenges and turn them into clear, compelling proposals together with our scientists and Technical Program Managers. Negotiate commercial terms and bring agreements to signature. Turn first engagements into lasting relationships, and spot where a partner can do more with us. Shape how we go to market Help decide which customer types and sectors to focus on first, based on what converts fastest. Bring what you hear in the market back to our product, research and leadership teams. Help build the processes, materials and playbook that the wider team will use as we grow. Represent CuspAI at industry events and conferences. What We're Looking For Someone who has sold to or partnered with R&D, chemicals or materials organizations, and who enjoys building something new more than running a process that already works. 8+ years in partnerships, business development or sales roles selling to industrial R&D, materials, chemicals or semiconductor organizations. Experience bringing digital R&D tools to scientific teams, for example materials informatics, lab data platforms (ELN, LIMS) or simulation software. A track record of sourcing and closing B2B deals with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles. A network among R&D and business leaders at US industrial companies. The ability to explain AI and computational concepts clearly to scientists and business leaders alike. Comfort with ambiguity, and the drive to build structure from scratch in a fast-growing startup. Willingness to travel regularly within the US and to Europe. Bonus Points (But Not Critical) An advanced degree in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering or a related field. Experience at a company working in materials informatics, scientific software or AI for R&D. Experience building a market or commercial function from the ground up. Location This role is based in the UK ideally London or Cambridge or Berlin oder Amsterdam, ideally near a major materials, chemicals or semiconductor hub. Expect regular travel to customer sites and to our offices in the UK and Europe (30 - 40 %) What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Run regular partner pipeline and performance reviews. Measure success through active partners, partner-generated pipeline and partner-generated ARR. title: Interim Performance Marketing Manager - 3 month contract
description: About Bike Club We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way. Bike Club is changing the way families access children's bikes. Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer. We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling. The Role We need a commercially driven performance marketer for three months to manage and improve customer acquisition across the UK and Germany while we hire a permanent Performance Marketing Manager. You will manage our performance marketing agency and own delivery of our paid acquisition plan, using customer and commercial data to recommend where to invest, test and optimise. We are also open to a fractional role for the right candidate. What You'll Do Manage our performance marketing agency and other acquisition partners, challenging recommendations where needed. Oversee day-to-day performance and optimisation of paid acquisition across the UK and Germany. Lead the restructure of paid search around parent needs and intent (sizing, outgrown bikes, exchange) rather than subscription terms. Recommend how acquisition budget is allocated across markets, channels and campaigns. Own reporting on CAC, conversion, ROAS, payback and customer value, working with Finance and Data. Set up a simple test-and-learn roadmap across channels, audiences, propositions, creative and landing pages. Focus on acquiring high-quality, sustainable customers, not just volume. What success looks like at three months Acquisition delivered to plan in the UK and Germany. Clear acquisition KPIs and reporting in place. Paid search restructure under way, with an accountable relationship with the agency. A documented test roadmap and handover for the permanent hire. About You You'll be an experienced performance marketer who combines channel knowledge with strong commercial and analytical judgement. Experience in performance marketing or growth within a consumer business or agency. Experience managing agencies and a multi-channel market. Strong analytical and commercial judgement, able to turn data into clear actions. Able to land quickly and work well with Marketing, Data, Finance and Commercial colleagues. German market experience is a plus. Available immediately! Why BikeClub? You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow. This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of Bike Club's growth, while helping build a more sustainable way for families to access children's bikes. title: Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management (UK/EU)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>About Summit:</strong></p> <p>Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:</p> <p><strong>Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Colorectal Cancer (CRC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.</em></p> <p></p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Job Title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Location: Oxford, UK or Zug, Switzerland or Dublin, Ireland</span></strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Overview of Role:</strong></p> <p>The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities. The role translates functional strategy into disciplined execution across demand and supply planning, inventory management, packaging and labelling, distribution, returns and destruction, cross-border compliance, and GxP operations. Acting as a key delegate for the Senior Director, the (Associate) Director provides a layer of management for direct reports, establishes clear priorities and performance expectations, develops team capability, and drives operational excellence through standardized processes, meaningful metrics, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Commercial, CMC, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Medical Affairs and Program Management, and oversees external partners including Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), IXRS providers and specialist service providers.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role and Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supports the Senior Director in developing functional strategy, operating plans, budgets, governance and performance objectives across global clinical supply chain activities</li> <li>Leads day-to-day execution for new and ongoing studies and products, ensuring robust forecasting, supply planning, schedule adherence, inventory optimization, global logistics and sustained GxP compliance</li> <li>Serves as a delegate for the Senior Director in cross-functional forums, governance meetings, supplier reviews and issue escalation, providing clear recommendations and ensuring timely follow-through.</li> <li>Manages and develops direct reports, translating functional priorities into individual objectives, balancing workloads, coaching performance, supporting career development and ensuring appropriate succession and capability plans.</li> <li>Creates an effective management layer by coordinating team activities, reinforcing accountability, removing operational barriers and escalating material risks or decisions to the Senior Director.</li> <li>Overseeing the Clinical Supply Management (CSM) team, the Associate Director interprets complex clinical protocols, development plans and commercial demand forecasts, working with CMC and internal and external partners to develop packaging, labelling, supply and resupply strategies, timelines and plans.</li> <li>Supports the accountability of CSM team to oversee packaging, labelling, release, distribution, resupply, returns, reconciliation and destruction activities across global locations</li> <li>Develops and maintains supply project budgets, resource plans and integrated schedules, monitors performance and proactively resolves variances</li> <li>Manages CDMO and service-provider activities from RFP and contracting support through routine operations, troubleshooting, invoicing and performance management using defined KPIs and service expectations</li> <li>Supports IXRS selection, design, set-up, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), implementation and ongoing operational performance as required by IRT Management Team.</li> <li>Drives operational excellence by defining standard work, governance routines, KPIs and dashboards; uses trend and root-cause analysis to improve service, quality, cost, compliance and team productivity</li> <li>Leads continuous-improvement initiatives that streamline and harmonize processes, strengthen inspection readiness and embed sustainable ways of working</li> <li>Supports regulatory submissions, audits and inspections and ensures timely management of SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs within the function</li> <li>Provides continuity of leadership and performs other responsibilities within the function as assigned</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BSc, MSc, engineering or pharmacy degree, or equivalent, with a minimum of 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) environment</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading complex international clinical studies and product supply chains, with broad knowledge of regulatory and GMP requirements for IMP and commercial product packaging and supply</li> <li>Prior people-management experience, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing talent, delegating effectively and managing through others</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable priorities, operating rhythms, metrics and measurable team outcomes</li> <li>Strong operational-excellence and continuous-improvement capability, including process standardization, KPI management, root-cause analysis and sustainable implementation of improvements</li> <li>Solid understanding of IXRS design specifications, set-up and UAT, together with proficiency in clinical supply planning and forecasting tools</li> <li>Strong project, budget, risk and resource-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality results</li> <li>Expertise in outsourcing, supplier governance, negotiation and performance management</li> <li>Experience building, scaling or improving end-to-end product supply chains and associated business processes</li> <li>Ability to operate as a trusted deputy to the Director, exercise sound judgement within delegated authority and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations</li> <li>Confident communicator able to influence all levels of the organization and build effective relationships with global colleagues, customers and suppliers</li> <li>Able to work independently with complex global problems while fostering inclusion, collaboration, accountability and effective team leadership</li> <li>Agile and resilient in a dynamic organization where priorities may change rapidly</li> <li>Knowledge of the drug development process and applicable FDA, EMA and PMDA expectations, including GMP, GCP, Annex 13 and relevant clinical trial requirements</li> <li>Technically proficient with industry-standard systems and tools and able to use technology, data and industry trends to improve efficiency and decision-making</li> <li>Knowledgeable of and compliant with SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>This is the pay for this position</p></div><div class="title">Pay Transparency</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$83,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$97,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.</p> <p>Summit does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact Summit’s Talent Acquisition team at <a ----- ----- obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to Summit.</p> <p><span data-teams="true">Summit Therapeutics Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in creating and maintaining diverse environment.
